## PR 304

**AI 360 home screen — what is running, what it cost, what it decided**

**বাংলায়:** AI ৩৬০ কন্ট্রোল রুম: সাতটা নির্দিষ্ট এজেন্টের কার্ড — চালু/বন্ধ, কাজ করছে কি না, আজ-এই মাসের খরচ, সবশেষ কাজ, আর একটা পজ বোতাম। চাবি না আসা পর্যন্ত খরচ ও কাজ সৎভাবে শূন্য। S15 আবার খোলা (CN-039), পাতা এখনো লুকানো।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: AI 360 home screen (S15 reopened, CN-039; no migration — the full schema from S00; permissions `ai.read`, `ai.control`): AI › Control room (`/admin/ai`, Lumen): the seven fixed agents (জ্ঞানী Gyani, প্রহরী Prohori, ভান্ডারী Bhandari, সওদাগর Sawdagor, শিল্পী Shilpi, দূত Doot, তীরন্দাজ Tirondaj) each as a card — on/off, working now (only while the master switch `ai.enabled` from PR 508 is also on), today's and this month's cost summed from `AiUsageLedger` in the store's own day/month, last activity from `AiDiaryEntry`; four summary tiles (running now, today's cost, this month's cost, the monthly cap read from `ai.monthlyCapMinor`, never invented); a pause/resume switch per agent (`ai.control`, audited, idempotent, reversible with Undo). With no AI provider wired and no job run yet, cost and activity are honestly zero/empty. The master switch itself, per-agent cap and schedule are PR 305+. ## PR 305

**Master switch**

**বাংলায়:** AI-র মেইন সুইচ এখন কন্ট্রোল রুম থেকেই চালু-বন্ধ করা যায়; সীমা না দেওয়া থাকলে সতর্ক করে। প্রতিটা এজেন্টের নিজের "AI বন্ধ থাকলেও চালু রাখুন" সুইচ — মেইন সুইচ বন্ধ করলেও সে থামে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Master switch and per-agent keep-on behaviour (C1.3; no migration — `AiAgent.keepOnWhenMasterOff` and the `ai.enabled` setting both already in the full S00 schema/registry; permission `ai.control`): AI › Control room's banner now turns the business-wide `ai.enabled` switch on or off itself (`POST /api/admin/ai {master}`, MasterSwitch, idempotent, reversible with Undo; its own SettingChange is the audit trail, no second log), with a money-safety note while no monthly cap is set yet. Each agent card gets its own "keep running even when AI is off" switch (`POST /api/admin/ai {key, keepOnWhenMasterOff}`, KeepOnSwitch, audited, idempotent) — a property of every agent, confirmed for Photoshoot but, as the owner said, "as with any agent". `workingNow` is now true whenever an agent is on AND (the master switch is on OR it is kept on); the status pill says "kept on" when that is why an agent is working while AI is off. Admin guide updated.
  - GitHub pull request #109, 11 Nov

## PR 306

**Multi-provider adapter: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, all dynamic**

**বাংলায়:** AI 360-এর লেখায় এখন চারটা সত্যিকার সেবা জুড়লো — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google আর OpenRouter — চাবি ও সংযোগ পাতায় একটা করে সারি। চাবি ও model না দেওয়া এবং test পাস না করা পর্যন্ত আগের মতোই অনুশীলনের লেখা হয়; একসাথে কয়েকটা চালু রাখা যায়, ফ্রি model লাইভে ব্যবহার হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Multi-provider adapter: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, all dynamic (C1.5; no migration — `AiProvider`/`AiModel` and `AI_PROVIDER` already in the full S00 schema; `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer/`): the AI writer's practice-only adapter (PR 221/293/243) gets its first four live providers — one key + one model id each (the owner types the model id his key may use; no model name trusted as current, per the blueprint), each a row in Keys & connections (`exclusive: false`, several may be on at once, like the payment gateways). Every provider answers the exact same `AiWriter` contract through one shared prompt-and-parse layer (`prompts.ts`, `live.ts`) — "write only from the facts given, reply as one JSON object" — so a draft from Claude, GPT, Gemini or an OpenRouter model is read the same way; a model that answers with anything else is a clean `AdapterError`, never a guess. OpenAI and OpenRouter share one Chat-Completions-shaped completer (`openai-compatible.ts`); OpenRouter's two attribution headers are optional. Falls back to the practice writer until a connection's key and model are in and its Test (one real sample SEO draft) passes. Free / OpenRouter-style models stay a hard no in production until PR 580's qualification; per-agent/per-job model choice is PR 307. Keys & connections guide updated with the four new rows.
  - GitHub pull request #113, 11 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** Multi-provider adapter: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, all dynamic
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer/`, `prompts.ts`, `live.ts`, `openai-compatible.ts`
  - Names in the code: `AiProvider`, `AiModel`, `AI_PROVIDER`, `exclusive: false`, `AiWriter`, `AdapterError`
  - Tests: Falls back to the practice writer until a connection's key and model are in and its Test (one real sample SEO draft) passes
- **Owning agent:** Gyani
- **Mentions:** [PR 221](S11.md#pr-221), [PR 293](S14.md#pr-293), [PR 243](S12.md#pr-243), [PR 580](#pr-580), [PR 307](#pr-307)

## PR 307

**Per-agent model selection, with the recommendation note beside each**

**বাংলায়:** AI ৩৬০-এ প্রতিটা এজেন্টের নিজের মডেল বাছাইয়ের ড্রপডাউন হলো — প্র্যাকটিস রাইটার বা টেস্ট-পাস-করা একটা সরবরাহকারী। ক্লডের নিজের পছন্দ সুপারিশ করা থাকে একটা পিল দিয়ে, আর বাছাই বদলালে নিচে সৎ একটা নোট দেখায় — এখনই সংখ্যা বানিয়ে বলা হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Per-agent model selection, with the recommendation note beside each (C1.5; migration `0187_agent_selected_provider`, additive — `AiAgent.selectedProvider`, `null` = the practice writer; permission `ai.control`): each agent card in AI › Control room gets its own model picker (`ModelPickSelect`, the practice writer plus the four PR 306 connections; `POST /api/admin/ai {key, provider}`, audited `ai.agent.model`, idempotent). A connection that is not yet keyed and Tested is listed but disabled, so the owner can never point an agent at one that would only fall back anyway (`PROVIDER_NOT_READY`). Claude's own pick is recommended by default — the first ready provider, Anthropic first — shown with a "Recommended" pill; the note beside the select always explains the effect honestly: it matches the recommendation, or says plainly that per-run cost/quality comparisons wait for the AI Cost Book (PR 312) rather than inventing a number not yet measured. An agent's stored pick whose connection later goes dark or un-Tested quietly falls back to the practice writer, with its own note, never a silent error — no AiModel catalogue row is read or written yet (that is PR 312/580's job). Admin guide updated.

## PR 308

**Per-agent schedule**

## PR 309

**Per-agent monthly spend cap**

**বাংলায়:** AI ৩৬০-এ প্রতিটা এজেন্টের নিজের মাসিক খরচের সীমা হলো — খালি রাখলে সীমা নেই। সীমার ৮০% ছুঁলে মালিকের Telegram-এ বাংলায় সতর্কতা যায় (সত্যিকারের পাঠানো, আন্দাজ নয়), ১০০%-এ নতুন কাজ থামার কথা পিলে দেখা যায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Per-agent monthly spend cap, with the 80% warning and the 100% pause (C1.6; no migration — `AiAgent.monthlyCapMinor` already in the full S00 schema, additive, unused until now; permission `ai.control`): each agent card in AI › Control room gets its own monthly spend cap (`CapInput`, new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/spend-cap.ts`) — a plain amount in the store's own currency, major units, empty is "no cap" (off, the default). `POST /api/admin/ai {key, monthlyCapMinor}` validates the value (422 `INVALID_CAP` for anything but `null` or a whole number 1..2,147,483,647), audits `ai.agent.cap`, idempotent. `agentCapState` (none/ok/warned/paused, whole-number cross-multiplication so the 80% line is exact, never a float) and `wouldExceedCap` are built as pure, tested enforcement primitives ready for the job dispatcher to call before paying for one more run — no such dispatcher exists yet, since nothing in the codebase writes an `AiUsageLedger` row outside a test fixture (PR 306/307/308 are equally honest about this). What is real and live, not speculative: `checkAgentCapAlerts`, run on every read of the Control room, which sends the owner's Telegram warning the moment any agent's spend crosses 80%/100% of its own cap — deduplicated through the audit log (`ai.agent.capWarn80`/`ai.agent.capPaused`, once per crossing per month), never throwing (a Telegram hiccup never breaks the screen). The owner reads only চলতি বাংলা (CLAUDE.md), so the alert text is always Bengali, independent of whichever language an English-reading staff member has the admin UI itself set to; at 100% new generations would pause (already-approved output stays live, the shop unaffected) — the worked example the Blueprint gives for the Photoshoot agent, now true "as with any agent", the same widening PR 305 did for keep-on. Admin guide updated.
  - GitHub pull request #125, 11 Nov

## PR 310

**Data-class routing — which class of data may reach which class of model**

**বাংলায়:** কোন তথ্য কোন AI মডেল পর্যন্ত যাবে তার নির্দিষ্ট নিয়ম হলো: ব্যক্তিগত বা ব্যবসার তথ্য কখনো ফ্রি-সক্ষম সংযোগে যায় না, এজেন্ট তা বাছলেও পাতা নিজে থেকেই টাকা-দেওয়া সংযোগ ব্যবহার করে আর কারণ লেখে; প্রকাশ্য/খসড়া লেখায় ফ্রি-সক্ষম সংযোগ চলে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Data-class routing (A5.2, A5.6; no migration — purely a structural policy in code, like the agent catalogue; no owner setting): new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/data-classes.ts` — the three Blueprint A5.2 data classes (personal, business, public/draft) and each of the seven fixed agents' own class (Gyani/Bhandari/Sawdagor personal, Prohori/Tirondaj business, Shilpi/Doot public/draft), plus `routeProvider`, which applies the Locked policy on top of PR 307's own model pick: personal and business work never effectively reaches OpenRouter (the one connection that can carry a free-tier model) even when the owner picks it and it is Tested-ready — the screen quietly uses the cheapest ready paid connection instead (or honestly the practice writer when none is ready) and explains why; public/draft work may use it as picked. `controlRoomView` now also returns each agent's `dataClass`/`effectiveProvider`/`routingDowngraded`. AI › Control room gains a data-class pill on every agent's model row and a new "Which data may reach which model" policy card stating the Locked rule itself, read-only. Per-job data-class tagging (one job can outrank its agent's own default) arrives with the AI Cost Book's 60–90 job rows (PR 312); until then the agent-level class can only ever be as careful as, or more careful than, that finer one. Admin guide updated.

## PR 311

**The masking layer applied before anything leaves the server**

**বাংলায়:** সার্ভার থেকে কিছু বেরোনোর ঠিক আগে একটা মাস্কিং স্তর বসলো — AI-কে পাঠানো লেখায় ফোন নম্বর বা ইমেইল থাকলে তা সঙ্গে সঙ্গে ঢেকে দেওয়া হয়; এখনো কোনো কাজ আসল কাস্টমারের তথ্য পাঠায় না, তাই এটা আগে থেকেই তৈরি একটা নিরাপত্তা স্তর।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: The masking layer applied before anything leaves the server (A5.1–A5.4, FAQ 55; no migration, no owner setting, no admin page — a transport-level safety net, not a screen): new `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer/masking.ts` — `maskPersonalData` is a pattern-based safety net that strips every e-mail address and Bangladeshi-shaped phone number (however punctuated or prefixed: bare, `+880`, `880`, or the full `00880` international dial) out of a piece of text, replacing each with a plain `[EMAIL]`/`[PHONE]` token; `maskKnownIdentity` is exact-value stripping for a future job that already holds a real customer record (name/phone/e-mail/address), case-insensitive, three-character minimum so a stray initial is left alone. `liveAiWriter` (live.ts) now wraps every provider's `Completer` so `system`/`user` are masked right before the one call in the package that actually leaves the server over HTTP — a safety net layered on top of whatever provider-routing policy the data carries, never a replacement for one. Today's three draft kinds (SEO, campaign, article) carry no real customer content, so this is built ahead of the S14/S22 jobs that will send one (support replies, rider notes) — the same honestly-inert-until-wired shape earlier S15 PRs shipped before any AI key existed; `maskKnownIdentity` is exported and fully tested but not yet called by any job. No admin page changes.

## PR 312

**AI Cost Book — 60–90 job rows, searchable, with the model selector in the row**

**বাংলায়:** AI কস্ট বুক এলো — দোকানের ৬৫টা AI কাজের একটা খুঁজে-দেখার তালিকা, প্রতিটায় সুপারিশ করা মডেল ও কারণ, আনুমানিক খরচ, আর সরাসরি মডেল বদলানোর বাছাই। এখনো কোনো কাজ সত্যিকার চলেনি, তাই খরচ সৎভাবে শুধু আনুমানিক।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: AI Cost Book — 60–90 job rows, searchable, with the model selector in the row (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C2.1, C2.2; no migration — `AiProvider`/`AiModel`/`AiJobType` already in the full S00 schema, additive, unused until now; permissions `ai.read`, `ai.control`): AI › Cost Book (`/admin/ai/cost-book`, Lumen), a new tab beside Control room and Checklist audit. A reference price catalogue (new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/cost-book.ts`) of 16 models across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, FASHN, Stability, Runway, Pika and a server-render vendor, seeded into `AiProvider`/`AiModel` on first read (idempotent, `ensureCostBookSeeded`, the same upsert pattern as `ensureAgentRows`); 65 job types across the Blueprint's own eight sections (Support, Orders, Marketing, Social, SEO & blog, Site audit, Reports, Admin helpers) plus a ninth, Studio, with a row for every photoshoot/video sub-job the Blueprint names (ghost mannequin, try-on, detail re-projection, upscale, finishing, detail finder, quality scoring, image-to-video, reel assembly), seeded into `AiJobType`. Each row shows what the job does, Claude's own recommended model and why (small/cheap for classification and parsing, mid for writing, large only where real reasoning is needed), an estimated cost per run and per month (a believable `typicalRunsPerDay` baseline, never real usage — no job runner reads this yet), every other same-kind model's own cost (Alternatives), and a model selector that writes immediately (`POST /api/admin/ai/cost-book {jobKey, modelKey}`, `ai.control`, audited `ai.costBook.model`, idempotent, refused 422 for an unknown model or one of the wrong kind). Cost is priced in USD (how every AI vendor bills) and shown in the store's own currency through the owner's own USD rate (`ExchangeRate`/`pricerFor`, PR 345/266) once he has typed one; until then every figure is shown honestly in USD, with a plain note why, never an invented taka amount. A searchable table (`CostBookSearch`, client-side, no round trip) and a "10 priciest jobs" section (C2.3). Honest notes printed on the page itself (C2.4): text is cheap, image generation is far more expensive, video assembly costs server time rather than tokens, and every estimate carries a ±10–15% band until real usage arrives. Out of scope, each its own PR: estimate-vs-actual self-correction (313), the what-if slider and Economy/Balanced/Premium presets (314), the free-form cost calculator reachable from Telegram (316) — the shared usage ledger (315) was already built by PR 309. ## PR 313

**Estimate versus actual, and the self-correction that follows**

**বাংলায়:** কস্ট বুকে এখন অনুমানের পাশে 'ঠিক খরচ' কলাম — কোনো কাজের অন্তত ৫টা সত্যিকার রান গত ৩০ দিনে হয়ে থাকলে আসল গড় খরচ আর অনুমানের চেয়ে কত বেশি/কম তা দেখায়। এখনো কোনো কাজ সত্যিকার চলেনি, তাই সব কাজেই এই কলাম খালি — সত্যিকার তথ্য এলে নিজে নিজে ভরে উঠবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Estimate versus actual, and the self-correction that follows (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C2.3; no migration — `AiJobType.actualPerRunMicros` already in the full S00 schema, additive, tagged for this PR, unused until now): a second, independent "Actual (last 30 days)" figure beside every job's estimate in the Cost Book, read from `AiUsageLedger.jobTypeKey` (PR 315's own ledger; still no job dispatcher writes a real row, honestly null exactly as `spend-cap.ts` already says of the same table) and persisted into `AiJobType.actualPerRunMicros` so a report elsewhere can read it without recomputing. `cost-book.ts` gains `actualOf` (the average real cost per run and its % deviation from the estimate) and `actualAggregatesSince` (one `AiUsageLedger.groupBy` for the whole book, not one query per job); shown only once `MIN_ACTUAL_SAMPLES` (5) real runs exist within `ACTUAL_WINDOW_DAYS` (30, the same length as the book's own monthly estimate), so one stray run never reads as "the real cost" — this never overwrites the estimate or the owner's own model pick; the owner reads both and decides. New column in `/admin/ai/cost-book`'s table and its own strings (`admin-ai.{bn,en}.json`); the honest C2.4 note updated to explain the band narrows once real data exists. 4 new pure tests (`actualOf`'s own math) + 1 new DB test (null with no usage, ignores a too-old run, fills in and persists once the threshold is reached, stays null for an untouched job) — 86/86 admin-ai tests green. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/cost-book.md` updated in the same commit.

## PR 315

**One shared usage ledger behind every figure**

**বাংলায়:** AI-র প্রতিটা খরচের পেছনে এখন একটাই ভাগাভাগি করা হিসাবের খাতা লেখার পথ তৈরি — যেকোনো আসল AI কাজ একবার চললে তার খরচ ঠিক একইভাবে গণনা হয়ে এক জায়গায় লেখা হবে, যাতে এজেন্টের মাসিক সীমা আর কস্ট বুকের 'ঠিক খরচ' কলাম কখনো দুই রকম হিসাব না দেখায়। USD রেট বসানো না থাকলে টাকার অঙ্ক বানিয়ে লেখা হয় না — সত্যিকার কাজ চালানোর কোনো যন্ত্র এখনো নেই, তাই এটাও এখনো ব্যবহার হচ্ছে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: One shared usage ledger behind every figure (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.6/C2.6; no migration — `AiUsageLedger` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here): new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/usage-ledger.ts` — `recordAiUsage`, the single shared write path every future AI job dispatcher is meant to call for a real run's cost, so the two figures that already read this table (PR 309's `agentCapState`/`checkAgentCapAlerts` by `agentId`+`costMinor`, PR 313's `actualOf` by `jobTypeKey`+`costUsdMicros`) are always fed from one computation instead of each future writer risking its own currency drifting apart from the Cost Book's own estimate. Reuses `cost-book.ts`'s own cost model (`estimateMicrosFor`/`modelOf`/`microsToUsdMinor`) rather than a second pricing table. As honest as every other AI 360 module about the one thing still true: no job dispatcher exists yet, so nothing in the real codebase calls this in production. `costMinor` (the store's own currency) is never invented when no USD rate has been typed (CLAUDE.md rule 1, CN-016): `recordAiUsage` honestly refuses with `{ok: false, error: 'NO_EXCHANGE_RATE'}` rather than guessing one — a real job dispatcher is expected to hold the usage and retry once a rate exists, never to write a guessed figure into a column PR 304/309 already trust. Idempotent on the schema's own unique `idempotencyKey` column: a retry (timeout, re-delivered job message) returns the first call's own result with `idempotent: true`, including the rare race where two concurrent callers share a key (caught via the unique-constraint violation, `P2002`, not a read-then-write check, which cannot by itself prevent the race). Throws only for a genuine caller bug (`UNKNOWN_MODEL`, `WRONG_KIND` — a model's kind not matching the usage shape given, `UNKNOWN_AGENT`). No admin page: this is the write-side library behind figures already shown by PR 304/312/313's own pages, not a new screen, so no new admin guide is needed. 5 new DB tests (`usage-ledger.db.test.ts`: refuses with no USD rate and writes nothing; throws for each caller-bug case and writes nothing; once a rate exists, computes the exact same micros the Cost Book's own math would, resolves the agent id, and a retry is idempotent; a job with no agent attached writes a null `agentId`, never a guessed one; the written rows are summed correctly by both PR 309's and PR 313's own query shapes) — 112/112 admin-ai tests green (was 107/107 after PR 314). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean. ## PR 316

**Free-form cost calculator**

**বাংলায়:** AI কস্ট বুকে এখন একটা মুক্ত-হাতের ক্যালকুলেটর যোগ হলো — নিজের কথায় একটা কাজ বেছে, কতবার চালাবেন তা লিখে, খরচ আগেই দেখে নেওয়া যায়; একসাথে কয়েকটা কাজ মিলিয়ে একটা পুরো পরিকল্পনার মোট খরচও বের করা যায়, আর পছন্দ হলে নাম দিয়ে পরে দেখার জন্য সেভ করে রাখা যায়। টেলিগ্রাম থেকে একই জিনিস জিজ্ঞাসা করার সুবিধা এখনো আসেনি, সেটা পরের একটা কাজ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Free-form cost calculator (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C2.5; no migration — `AiCostPlan` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.control`): beside the Cost Book's own job table, a calculator (new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/calculator.ts`, `calculator-api.ts`, `POST /api/admin/ai/cost-book/calculator`, new `CostBookCalculator.tsx`) where the owner describes a piece of work as one or more lines — an existing Cost Book job, how many runs, and optionally how much bigger/smaller than the job's own usual run (e.g. a longer article) — and gets a cost before committing, up to 5 lines at once; a composite question ("10 blog posts with 3 images each") becomes two priced lines totalled together. Reuses the Cost Book's own cost model (`jobOf`/`modelOf`/`estimateMicrosFor`/`alternativesFor`/`microsToUsdMinor`, PR 312) rather than a second one, so the calculator's number for a job can never disagree with that job's own row in the book; `calculateLine`/`calculatePlan` are pure (no DB) and reusable by any future caller, with the DB-aware `planView`/`savePlan` the only functions touching Prisma. A single-line plan not already on the job's own recommended model, where that recommendation is genuinely cheaper, gets a one-line savings note; a composite plan stays silent rather than guessing which line to flag. "Save as plan" (`ai.control`) persists the estimate onto `AiCostPlan` (a single-job plan remembers its `jobTypeKey`, a composite one leaves it null), audited `ai.calculator.plan`, so a later PR can compare it against a real run's cost once a job dispatcher exists (`actualMicros` stays null until then, the same honest gap PR 306/307/308/309/312/313/315 already note). Out of scope, its own later PR: Blueprint C2.5's "reachable from Telegram" — no inbound Telegram command handling exists anywhere in this codebase yet (the Telegram adapter, PR 392, is outbound-only), and that webhook/intent layer is shared, reusable infrastructure PR 317's approval queue will also need, not something to grow inside this PR; `AiCostPlan.createdVia` is already shaped for it (`'admin'` here, `'telegram'` later) so no column needs to change when it arrives. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/cost-book.md` updated in the same commit with the new Calculator section. 12 new pure tests (`calculator.test.ts`: exact cost math for a text and an image job, alternatives, scale, model override, the null-store honesty when no exchange rate exists, every error case, the single-line recommendation note, composite totals) + 7 new DB tests (`calculator-api.db.test.ts`: only `ai.control` may price or save a plan; a single-line and a composite plan price correctly and write nothing on preview; each caller-input error is refused; "Save as plan" writes exactly one `AiCostPlan` row and one audit entry with the exact estimate; a composite plan's saved row carries no single `jobTypeKey`; saving without a description is refused and saves nothing) — 126/126 admin-ai tests green (was 112/112 after PR 315). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean. Fifth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): directly extends `cost-book.ts`/`page.tsx`, still-unmerged PR 312 files, same stacking as 313/314/315. Carries forward PR 315's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 310/311 landing on `main`, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile.

## PR 317

**The single approval queue — everything waiting on the owner, in one place**

**বাংলায়:** এখন থেকে কোনো AI এজেন্ট একা করতে পারে না এমন সব কাজ — টাকা, রিফান্ড, COD বদল, দাম, ছাড়, বিজ্ঞাপনের বাজেট, ব্লক করা বা মুছে ফেলা — একটাই অপেক্ষার তালিকায় এসে জমা হবে (AI › অনুমোদন), পুরনো থেকে নতুন ক্রমে, যাতে মালিক এক বসায় সব ক্লিয়ার করতে পারেন। সাইট স্বাস্থ্যের সমাধান আর নতুন স্কিলের অনুমোদন আগে থেকেই যেখানে হতো, সেটাই থাকছে — এই তালিকায় শুধু সেগুলো একসাথে দেখা যাবে, সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার জায়গা বদলাচ্ছে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: The single approval queue — everything waiting on the owner, in one place (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C3.2; no migration — `AiApprovalRequest` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.control` to decide, `ai.read` to see): AI › Approvals (`/admin/ai/approvals`, Lumen, new tab beside Control room/Cost Book) — everything an AI 360 agent wants to do but may not do alone (money movement, refund, COD change, price change, discount, ad-budget increase, blocking, deletion), in one queue, oldest first, so the owner clears it "in one pass". New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/approvals.ts`: `requestApproval` (creates a pending request, deduped by `refType`+`refId` so a retried job or a double "ask the owner" call never queues the same thing twice), `expireStaleApprovals` (flips a stale `PENDING` row to `EXPIRED` on every read, the same "fresh on every read" pattern as the spend-cap alerts), `approvalsView` (every kind together, plus a short decided/expired/cancelled history, each decider's own name resolved once per view) and `decideApproval` (approve/reject with an optional note; a repeat tap with the *same* decision is a no-op, the *other* decision or anything already decided is refused with its real status, never silently overwritten). `KNOWN_KINDS`/`kindLabelOf` give a Bengali/English label for the Blueprint's own named categories while honestly falling back to the raw `kind` string for anything not yet named — `kind` stays a plain column, not a closed enum, so a future agent kind this PR did not foresee still works. **This table already has a real producer and decider — S21 · PR 420's `admin-health/fixes.ts` (Reports › Site health › Fixes to approve), which writes and decides `health.fix`/`ai.skill` requests with its own permission (`health.fixes.approve`) and its own side effects (a `SiteAuditFinding`/`AiSkill` row moves with the decision).** This PR is a thin, unifying *read* layer on top of the same table, never a second way to decide a fix or a skill: `approvalsView` lists every kind together so the owner genuinely sees everything in one place, but `decideApproval`/`requestApproval` both refuse a `GATE_KINDS` row outright (`USE_FIX_GATE`), and `POST /api/admin/ai/approvals` (`approvals-api.ts`) routes a `health.fix`/`ai.skill` row straight to `fixes.decideProposal` instead — same for `expireStaleApprovals`, called alongside `fixes.expireProposals` rather than touching its rows. The admin page (`page.tsx`, new `ApprovalDecideButtons.tsx`) shows every pending row with its kind, requesting agent, title and summary, gated per-row by whichever permission that row's kind actually needs (`ai.control` for this file's own kinds, `health.fixes.approve` for the two PR 420 owns), and a short decision history (status pill, who decided it and when, the note). A decision here is permanent, no Undo, matching CLAUDE.md's "never without the owner's written OK" for money/refunds/COD/prices/discounts/blocking/deletion — the tap itself *is* that written OK. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/approvals.md`. 3 new pure tests (`kindLabelOf`/`KNOWN_KINDS`) + 12 new DB tests (`approvals-api.db.test.ts`: only `ai.read` opens the queue; only `ai.control` decides this file's own kinds; a double tap with the same decision is a no-op, the other decision is refused; a stale request expires on read; a `health.fix`/`ai.skill` row cannot be created or decided through this file directly — only `fixes.ts`'s own `proposeFix`/`proposeSkill`/`decideProposal` may; such a row still lists in the same unified queue; a controller with only `ai.control` cannot decide it, a fix approver with only `health.fixes.approve` can, through this same unified API) — 15/15 approvals tests green, 199/199 admin-ai + admin-health tests green overall (confirms PR 420's own suite is unaffected by this read-only, import-only integration). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean. Sixth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): new files only, no edit to any still-unmerged PR 312–316 file. Carries forward PR 315/316's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 310/311 landing on `main`, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile.
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** The single approval queue — everything waiting on the owner, in one place
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)

  - Code and files: `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/approvals.ts`, `admin-health/fixes.ts`, `POST /api/admin/ai/approvals`, `approvals-api.ts`, `page.tsx`, `ApprovalDecideButtons.tsx`, `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/approvals.md`, `approvals-api.db.test.ts`, `fixes.ts`
  - Routes: `/admin/ai/approvals`
  - Settings and named keys: `ai.control`, `ai.read`, `health.fix`, `ai.skill`, `health.fixes.approve`, `fixes.decideProposal`, `fixes.expireProposals`
  - Names in the code: `AiApprovalRequest`, `requestApproval`, `refType`, `refId`, `expireStaleApprovals`, `PENDING`, `EXPIRED`, `approvalsView`, `decideApproval`, `KNOWN_KINDS`, `kindLabelOf`, `kind`, `SiteAuditFinding`, `AiSkill`, `GATE_KINDS`, `USE_FIX_GATE`, `proposeFix`, `proposeSkill`, `decideProposal`, `pr-312-ai-cost-book`, `main`
  - Tests: 3 new pure tests (`kindLabelOf`/`KNOWN_KINDS`) + 12 new DB tests (`approvals-api.db.test.ts`: only `ai.read` opens the queue
  - Tests: a controller with only `ai.control` cannot decide it, a fix approver with only `health.fixes.approve` can, through this same unified API) — 15/15 approvals tests green, 199/199 admin-ai + admin-health tests green overall (confirms PR 420's own suite is unaffected by this read-only, import-only integration)

## PR 318

**Permission matrix: what each agent may decide alone**

**বাংলায়:** প্রতিটা AI এজেন্টের নিজের কার্ডে এখন সাতটা বিষয় (অর্ডার, স্টক, দাম, কুরিয়ার, টাকা, কাস্টমারের তথ্য, কোড) দেখা যাবে, প্রতিটায় একা সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারবে, প্রথমে জিজ্ঞাসা করতে হবে, বা হাতই দিতে পারবে না — এই তিনটার একটা বাছাই করা থাকে (AI › পারমিশন)। যে ঘর মালিক এখনো বদলাননি সেটা সবচেয়ে নিরাপদ অবস্থায়, 'প্রথমে জিজ্ঞাসা করতে হবে' — মালিক না বাড়ালে কোনো এজেন্ট কখনো একা কিছু করতে পারবে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: Permission matrix: what each agent may decide alone (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C3.2; no migration — `AgentPermission` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.control` to change a cell, `ai.read` to see): AI › Permissions (`/admin/ai/permissions`, Lumen, new tab beside Approvals) — one card per fixed agent, over the Blueprint's own seven resources (orders, stock, prices, courier, money, customer data, code), each with a level the owner sets: **alone** (the agent decides and acts, no approval needed), **propose** (the agent may only ask — lands in PR 317's single approval queue) or **none** (the agent may not touch this resource at all, not even to propose). Every cell nobody has ever set reads as `propose`, never `alone` — the safe, off-by-default starting point CLAUDE.md rule 1/CN-018 require for every owner-set switch, shown on the page with its own "Default" badge so the owner can tell "never touched" apart from "chosen to match the default". New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/permissions.ts`: `RESOURCES` (the closed seven-key catalogue, English/Bengali labels, never falling back to a raw string the way `approvals.ts`'s `KNOWN_KINDS` does — a resource is a structural fact decided when a new kind of AI action is built, not an owner's or agent's input), `LEVELS`/`DEFAULT_LEVEL`, `permissionsView` (every fixed agent × every resource, default-filled), `setAgentPermission` (one cell, a no-op on a repeat of the same value, audited `ai.permission.set` otherwise) and the enforcement primitives `agentPermissionLevel`/`agentMayActAlone`/`agentMayProposeOrAct` — pure/tested and ready for the first real agent action (PR 583's chief-agent routing, S24's Photoshoot agent's own "media only, never price/stock/orders/customer data" rule) the same honest gap PR 304–317 already note: nothing in this codebase executes a real agent action yet, so nothing calls them in production. New `permissions-api.ts` (`GET`/`POST /api/admin/ai/permissions`; GET needs only `ai.read`; POST needs `ai.control`) and its route. New admin page (`page.tsx`, new `PermissionLevelSelect.tsx`, new `permissions.css`): one card per agent, a `<select>` per resource for anyone with `ai.control` (plain text otherwise), the same Undo-offering toast every other admin-ai switch here uses. Admin shell: a new `permissions` tab beside `approvals` in the `ai` section (`sections.ts`, `help-pages.json`, plus the `shell.tab.ai.permissions` label this PR adds — `approvals`' own tab label was found missing from the same block while adding this one, left for the rebase-merge coordinator rather than touched here, out of this PR's own scope), new strings `admin-ai.{bn,en}.json`'s `aiPermissions.*`, new Bengali page guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/permissions.md` (linked from `ai/index.md`). 8 new pure tests (`permissions.test.ts`: the resource catalogue's shape, `isResourceKey`/`resourceLabel`, `LEVELS`/`isPermissionLevel`, `DEFAULT_LEVEL` is `propose` not `alone`, `agentMayActAlone`/`agentMayProposeOrAct`) + 6 new DB tests (`permissions-api.db.test.ts`: all seven agents start at `propose`/default on every cell; only `ai.read` opens the matrix, only `ai.control` changes a cell; widening one cell to `alone` is audited and leaves every other cell untouched; narrowing a different cell to `none`, and a repeat of the same value is a no-op with no new audit row; an unknown agent/resource/level is refused; `agentPermissionLevel` reads the safe default for an untouched cell) — 14/14 permissions tests green, 155/155 admin-ai tests green overall (was 141/141 before this PR). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint/typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`, the shared runner's default heap otherwise OOMs on this repo's `tsc --noEmit`). ## PR 320

**Bug box: the agent reports what it could not do**

**বাংলায়:** একই ডায়েরি পাতায় এখন বাগ বক্স যুক্ত হয়েছে — সব/যা করেছে/বাগ বক্স তিনটা ট্যাব, প্রতিটার পাশে সংখ্যা, একই এজেন্ট আর দিনের সীমা ফিল্টারে চলে। বাগ বক্সে থাকে কোনো এজেন্ট কোনো কাজ করতে পারেনি আর কেন পারেনি তার লেখা — ডেমোর স্ক্রিন অনুযায়ী শুধু এজেন্টের লেখা, মালিকের নিজের প্রশ্ন লেখার জায়গা এখনো তৈরি হয়নি। কোনো এজেন্ট এখনো সত্যিকার কাজ করতে পারে না বলে এটাও এখনো খালি।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Bug box: the agent reports what it could not do (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.7; no migration — `AiBugReport` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.read`): the same AI › Diary page (`/admin/ai/diary`) gains a second segment and a 3-way tab nav (সব/যা করেছে/বাগ বক্স, each with its own count), filtered by the same agent + day-window controls as the diary half. **Scope decision, following CLAUDE.md's "the demo is the UI truth… match it":** the Blueprint's `AiBugReport` schema comment and C1.7's prose also describe a separate owner-facing "write a problem, AI investigates → explains → proposes → approves" flow, but the demo (`97y-adm2-ai.js`, screen AIC-09) shows only the read-only agent-reported "could not do" segment with no owner composer anywhere, and that investigate flow has no register PR number of its own and needs a real investigating agent that does not exist yet — so this PR builds only the agent-reported direction the demo actually shows, deferring the owner's own composer to a later, currently-unscoped PR (noted in the admin guide's "এরপর কী হয়"). New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/bugbox.ts`: `reportCouldNotDo` (one agent-written report — a title plus a plain-Bengali "why", status always starts `open`; resolves the real agent row via `ensureAgentRows`; throws only for an unknown agent key or an empty title/why) and `bugBoxView`, sharing PR 319's own `DIARY_DEFAULT_DAYS`/`DIARY_MAX_ROWS` constants and window/agent-filter logic exactly, so the two segments of one page always agree on what "recent" means. ## PR 321

**Skill library — import a skill, version it, roll it back**

**বাংলায়:** AI › স্কিল পাতা এখন আছে — প্রতিটা স্কিলের নাম, এজেন্ট, ভার্সন আর অবস্থা এক তালিকায়, অনুমোদিত স্কিল চালু/বন্ধ করা যায় আর এক চাপে আগের ভার্সনে ফেরানো যায় (পুরনো ভার্সন কখনো মুছে যায় না)। মালিক নিজে বাইরে থেকে একটা নতুন স্কিল "আনতে" পারেন, যা একই অনুমোদনের তালিকায় যায় আর আগের জায়গাতেই সিদ্ধান্ত হয়। স্কিল চালানোর যন্ত্র এখনো নেই, তাই চালু করা স্কিলও এখনো সত্যিকার কাজ করে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Skill library — import a skill, version it, roll it back (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.7 "Skill library" + "Import a skill from outside", demo screen AIC-04 "Skills › Library"; no migration — `AiSkill`/`AiSkillVersion`/`AiSkillExport` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.skills.write` to import/roll back/toggle, `ai.read` to see): AI › Skills (`/admin/ai/skills`, Lumen, new tab beside Permissions/Diary) — every `AiSkill` as a row (name, agent, version, status, updated-at) with, once approved, an on/off switch and a one-click "roll back" to the version before it, plus the owner's own "Import a skill" dialog. **Single-decision-path kept intact:** `fixes.ts`'s own `proposeSkill`/`decideProposal` (S21 · PR 420) is still the only producer/decider for an *agent-proposed* skill — this PR adds the owner's own direct entry point (`importSkill`, status always starts `proposed`, same vocabulary, same `AiApprovalRequest` row) so both paths land in the one queue PR 317 already reads and are decided in the one place `fixes.ts`'s own header comment already reserves ("the skill library, PR 321–323"); this file never decides a proposal itself. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/skills.ts`: `importSkill` (name + optional purpose, `AI_AGENTS`-checked agent key, a slugified unique `key` retried on collision, `AiSkillVersion` 1 written with placeholder content pending real authoring, an `AiApprovalRequest` created via the shared queue, audited `ai.skill.import`), `skillLibraryView` (every skill, newest-updated first, joined to its current/older approved version counts), `rollbackSkill` (moves `AiSkill.currentVersion` back one approved step — append-only, no row ever deleted, matching CLAUDE.md rule 3 — refuses with `NO_OLDER_VERSION` when none exists) and `setSkillEnabled` (only once `status==='approved'`, a no-op on a repeat of the same value, audited `ai.skill.enable`). As honest as every other S15 write path about the one thing that has not changed: no job dispatcher or skill-execution runtime exists yet, so an imported/enabled skill is not yet actually run by any agent — this PR builds the library's own management surface, not execution. New `skills-api.ts` (`GET`/`POST /api/admin/ai/skills`, `action` discriminator import/rollback/enable; GET needs `ai.read`, POST needs `ai.skills.write`) and its route. New admin page (`page.tsx`, new `SkillImportDialog.tsx`/`SkillRollbackButton.tsx`/`SkillEnableSwitch.tsx`, `ai.css` gains `.ai-sk-actions`): an `a2-tbl` table matching the demo's own column set, a status pill (proposed/rejected/expired/approved-on/approved-off), the import dialog gated behind `ai.skills.write`, and a read-only notice for anyone without it. New permission `ai.skills.write` (`catalogue.ts`, `auth.{en,bn}.json`), new admin-shell tab `skills` (`sections.ts`, `help-pages.json`, `admin-shell.{en,bn}.json`'s `tab.ai.skills`), new strings `admin-ai.{bn,en}.json`'s `aiSkills.*`, new Bengali page guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/skills.md` (six parts, linked from `ai/index.md`). 7 new DB tests (`skills.db.test.ts`): `importSkill` writes a version-1 skill plus one approval request and refuses an unknown agent/empty name; `skillLibraryView` lists newest-updated first with correct version counts; `rollbackSkill` moves the pointer back and refuses when no older approved version exists; `setSkillEnabled` only works once approved, is a no-op on a repeat value, and is audited. Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint clean, typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`). ## PR 322

**Skill sandbox: try a skill on real data without touching production**

**বাংলায়:** AI › স্কিল-এ এখন একটা "পরীক্ষার জায়গা" (Sandbox) ট্যাব আছে — কোনো স্কিল অনুমোদনের আগেই গত ৭ বা ৩০ দিনের আসল অর্ডারের উপর "পরীক্ষা" চালানো যায়, শুধু-পড়ার, কিছু লেখা/পাঠানো/কাটা হয় না। কতগুলো আসল অর্ডার পড়া হলো আর (সম্ভব হলে) আনুমানিক খরচ দেখায়; স্কিল আসলে কোন অর্ডারে কী করত তা এখনো বলা যায় না, কারণ কাজ চালানোর যন্ত্র তৈরি হয়নি — সংখ্যা বানিয়ে দেখানো হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Skill sandbox: try a skill on real data without touching production (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C10.4 "new lessons become versioned skills only after a sandbox test (PR 322)"; demo screen AIC-04a "Skill sandbox"; no migration — `AiSandboxRun` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.skills.write` to run a test, `ai.read` to see): AI › Skills › Sandbox (`/admin/ai/skills/sandbox`, new sub-page beside Library) — pick any skill (whatever its approval status — sandboxing happens before approval, per the Blueprint) and a 7- or 30-day order window, "Run in sandbox" reads a real, read-only count of the store's own orders placed in that window, nothing is written to `Order`, no message sent, no money moved. **Honest about what cannot yet be proven:** no skill-execution engine exists (every other S15 write path already says so), so this cannot know which real orders a skill's own instructions would act on — the demo's own "would get a flag" figure is a fabricated percentage with no real skill behind it, so this PR never carries that fabrication into production code. What it proves instead: `ordersRead` (the real count), `passed` (the tested version has real, non-placeholder content within `SKILL_CONTENT_MAX` and the read completed without error), and `estimatedCostMinor` — real only when the skill's own agent has at least one Cost Book job (`JOB_CATALOG`, PR 312; that job's own model and usage shape × `ordersRead`, priced via the exact same `pricerFor` PR 315/316 already use), else `null` with a `costNote` (`NO_AGENT_JOB`/`NO_EXCHANGE_RATE`) saying exactly why — never a guessed number. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/skill-sandbox.ts`: `runSkillSandbox` (always tests the newest version row, whatever the skill's status; writes one append-only `AiSandboxRun` row plus mirrors the result onto that `AiSkillVersion.sandboxResult`, audited `ai.skill.sandbox`) and `sandboxHistory` (newest-first run log for one skill, nothing ever deleted). `skills-api.ts` extended (not replaced): the same `/api/admin/ai/skills` route gains `{action:'sandbox', id, dataWindowDays}` (returns the run plus the skill's updated history in one response) and `GET ?sandboxHistory=<key>` (so the client can refetch another skill's own history without a page reload). New admin page (`page.tsx`, new `SkillSandboxForm.tsx` client component, `ai.css` gains `.ai-sbx-list`/`.ai-sbx-row`): a skill + data-window picker, a result card, and a run-history list, matching the demo's own two-page `A2B_SKSUB` nav (Library/Sandbox) via the shell's existing multi-page-tab mechanism (`SectionTabs`, new `nav.aiSkills`/`nav.aiSkillsSandbox` labels — the skills tab's first sub-page nav, so these labels did not exist before this PR). New strings `admin-ai.{bn,en}.json`'s `aiSkillsSandbox.*`, new help-pages row and Bengali page guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/skills-sandbox.md` (six parts, linked from `ai/index.md`; `skills.md`'s own "এরপর কী হয়" updated to link it, no longer "coming"). Permission `ai.skills.write`'s own label (`auth.{en,bn}.json`) extended to cover "or run a sandbox test" — the same permission, not a new one, since this is still skill management. 6 new DB tests (`skill-sandbox.db.test.ts`, the writer called straight): throws for an unknown data window, a missing skill, or one with no version yet, writing nothing; reads the real order count for 7- and 30-day windows, never touching `Order` itself, two append-only runs logged; honestly `NO_EXCHANGE_RATE` before any USD rate is typed; once a rate and a Cost Book job both exist, a real cost scales with orders read; honestly `NO_AGENT_JOB` for an agent with no Cost Book job at all, regardless of any rate; `passed` is false for placeholder-only content, true once real content exists; `sandboxHistory` lists newest first and stays unchanged by a later approval decision on the same skill. 253/253 admin-ai + admin-health tests green overall (was 247/247 before this PR). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings (3219 files), admin-guide-check clean, `shell.test.ts` green (26/26 — unaffected, since the new nav labels are read dynamically), lint clean, typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`). Eleventh commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): new files plus a small, additive extension of PR 321's own `skills-api.ts`/`sections.ts`/`help-pages.json`/`skills.md`/`auth.{en,bn}.json`, no behaviour of PR 321's own three existing actions changed. ## PR 323

**Continuous skill training — corrections become training examples**

**বাংলায়:** এখন থেকে AI › অনুমোদন পাতায় কোনো স্কিল "কারণ লিখে" বাতিল করলে, সেই কারণ আর স্কিলের লেখাটা ঐ এজেন্টের একটা "শেখার উদাহরণ" (training example) হয়ে ডেটাবেসে থেকে যায় — কারণ ছাড়া বাতিল করলে বা অনুমোদন করলে কিছু লেখা হয় না, আন্দাজ করে কিছু বানানো হয় না। এজেন্টের নিজের প্রোফাইল পাতায় (এখনো তৈরি হয়নি) এগুলো "ভুল থেকে শেখা" তালিকায় দেখানো হবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Continuous skill training — corrections become training examples (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.8 "every correction the owner makes becomes a training example"; C3.3 repeats the same standing requirement for every agent; the demo's own agent-profile screen `89b-admin-agents.js` shows the result as each agent's own "Lessons (owner corrections)" list; no migration — `AiTrainingExample` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this PR, written for the first time here; permission `ai.read` to see): the real plumbing behind that standing requirement, triggered from the one genuine "correction" moment the codebase has today — the owner rejecting an `ai.skill` proposal **with a reason**, through the one approval queue (PR 317) `fixes.decideProposal` (S21 · PR 420) already decides every skill through. **Only edit to an existing file:** `approvals-api.ts`'s own POST handler now also calls the new `recordSkillCorrection` right after such a rejection — the rejected version's own content becomes `input`, the owner's own reason becomes `expected`, tagged with the skill's own agent; approving, or rejecting with no reason, writes nothing (an honest gap, never a guessed lesson). New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/training.ts`: `recordSkillCorrection` (honest, not best-effort-fabricated — returns `null`, writing nothing, when there is no real version content or no real agent to credit) and `trainingExamplesView` (newest-first, never-archived examples, optionally narrowed by agent and/or skill; CLAUDE.md rule 3 — nothing here is ever deleted). **Honest about what has not changed:** the demo's own screen that would *read* this table — the agent-profile page's "Lessons (owner corrections)" list — is PR 577's own (C10.4), not yet built, and no training/fine-tuning pipeline consumes these rows yet either (the same gap PR 321/322 already note for the skill-execution engine). New `training-api.ts` + `GET /api/admin/ai/training` route (`ai.read`, optional `?agent=`/`?skill=`) — no dashboard page reads it yet (there is nowhere in the demo to put one before PR 577 exists), so this small read-only endpoint exists only so the data is already real and queryable the day that page is built. `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/skills.md`'s own "এরপর কী হয়" extended (not rewritten) to say so. 8 new DB tests (`training.db.test.ts`, the writer called straight plus the full real loop through `importSkill`/`approvalsHandler`/`fixes.decideProposal`): `recordSkillCorrection` honestly writes nothing for an unknown skill, an unmatched version or a blank reason; rejecting a real skill proposal with a reason writes exactly one training example tagged with the skill's own agent and key, audited `ai.training.correction`; rejecting with no reason writes nothing; approving writes nothing; rejecting a `health.fix` row (not a skill) writes nothing — this is a skill-only mechanic; `trainingExamplesView` narrows by agent and is an honest empty list for an unrecognised one; `GET /api/admin/ai/training` needs `ai.read` and answers the same rows newest first. Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings (3224 files), admin-guide-check clean (no new admin page), lint clean, typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`) — confirms every Prisma field name/type used (`AiTrainingExample`'s columns, `AiApprovalRequest.refId`/`agentKey`/`payload`) against the real generated client. **Verification note:** this session's sandboxed Postgres admin credentials could not be reset by the permission system (two attempts refused — "Permission Grant"/"Modify Shared Resources" — a shared instance other sessions may depend on), so the new `.db.test.ts` could not be run live here; it self-skips without `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL` exactly like every other one in the repo and will run for real in CI/the merge gate. The full non-DB admin-ai suite (106/106) stayed green, confirming no regression. ## PR 324

**AI-off fallback: every agent has a rule or template path that works without AI**

**বাংলায়:** AI › কন্ট্রোল রুমের "AI বন্ধ পরীক্ষা" কার্ডে এখন সত্যিকার সংখ্যা দেখায়, ডেমোর বানানো "৭/৭" নয় — কোডে একটা স্থির পরীক্ষা চালিয়ে বের করা আসল ফল। আজকের হিসাবে সাতটা ফিচারের (সাপোর্টের উত্তর, প্রতারণা বিচার, প্রোডাক্টের বর্ণনা, ব্লগ, বিজ্ঞাপন, সাইট অডিট, রিপোর্ট) সবগুলোর নিয়ম/টেমপ্লেট বিকল্প প্রমাণ মিলেছে, মোট ৬৫টা AI কাজের ২৭টা এতে কভার হয় — বাকিগুলো সৎভাবে এখনো বাকি কাজ। এটা কোনো লাইভ পরীক্ষা নয়, কোডে বদল হলেই আপনাআপনি CI-তে আবার চেক হয়, তাই কোনো "চালান" বোতাম নেই।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: AI-off fallback: every agent has a rule or template path that works without AI (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C1.4 "the AI-off principle" — "every AI-driven step has a rule-based or template-based fallback that runs when AI is off"; demo screen AIC-01's own "AI-off test" card, `97y-adm2-ai.js` lines ~106–124; permission `ai.read` to see, no write permission — a static scan has nothing to approve). **Scope decision (CLAUDE.md rule 1, "nothing hardcoded"/nothing invented — the demo's own card fabricates `ai.offTest = {n:7, ok:7}` the instant its button is pressed):** this PR never ships that fabrication. It reframes the card as a **deterministic static source scan** (`tools/ai-off-guard.mjs`, the exact method of the hardcode guard, PR 494 — rules as data in `tools/ai-off-guard.json`, never a live runtime test), proving that a first named set of AI-driven feature areas already has its deterministic rule/template fallback **merged and shipping today**, each proof a real file + the exact substring(s) that show it, never a guess. Since no AI job dispatcher exists yet (every S15 PR before this one says so honestly) there is nothing to run live in production either way — and the deployed image carries no TypeScript source to scan at runtime (`apps/web/Dockerfile`'s `run` stage is `.next/standalone` + `.next/static` + `public` only), so this also could not be a server-side "Run" button even if it tried. **What is actually checked, found already true of the real source tree today, and why each is a genuine AI-off fallback:** Support replies → `packages/support/src/drafts-pure.ts` (PR 432) — a pure keyword-rule draft engine, "without a database... first match wins", covering the catalogue's 7 `support*` jobs; Fraud judgement → `packages/orders/src/risk-score.ts` (PR 156) — "pure function (no database, no clock)... this file decides nothing about the order", covering `orderFraudJudge`; Product descriptions → `packages/catalogue/src/products.ts` — plain owner-editable `descriptionEn`/`descriptionBn` text fields, covering `mktProductDescription`; Blog writing → `packages/settings/src/registry-blog-pipeline.ts` (PR 591) — "The non-AI half of the pipeline... an empty slot is never filled with a weak post", covering `seoBlogArticle`/`seoRewriteOld`; Ads → `apps/web/src/lib/marketing/campaign-control.ts` (PR 268/531) — "nothing changes until a person with `marketing.ads.approve`"; "kept as PRACTICE, so no real budget or campaign changes", covering `mktAdCopy`/`mktCampaignBrief`; Site audit → `apps/web/src/lib/admin-health/audit.ts` (PR 570) — the rule-based `audit-checklist.json`, "generated from docs/qa/ECOMMERCE-CHECKLIST.md", "Nothing here fixes or deletes anything", covering the catalogue's 7 `audit*` jobs; Chief answers → `packages/jobs/src/money-report.ts` (PR 351) — `moneyReportText`'s own real Profit & loss figures, "Read-only: nothing moves money", covering the catalogue's 7 `reports*` jobs. New `tools/ai-off-guard.mjs` (+ `tools/ai-off-guard.json`, + `tools/ai-off-guard.test.mjs`, 8 pure tests): `parseJobCatalog` reads `JOB_CATALOG`'s (PR 312) real `{key, agentKey}` pairs straight off `cost-book.ts`'s own source text (call-start splitting, never naive paren-balancing, so a description's own comma or `)` can never desynchronise a later job's key); `coveredKeys` intersects a check's claimed job keys/prefixes against the catalogue that exists *today*, so a renamed or removed job is honestly dropped rather than over-claimed, and a check whose jobs all vanished fails as "stale" rather than silently passing on zero; `checkProofs` requires every named substring in every named file, reporting exactly what is missing rather than a bare pass/fail; `runGuard` is pure given its inputs and never touches the system clock except for the report's own `at`. Run today: **7/7 checks pass, covering 27 of the catalogue's 65 AI jobs** — the honest remainder (support/orders/marketing/social/seo/admin/studio jobs this PR does not yet name a proof for) is real, open follow-up work, never silently claimed as covered. `node tools/ai-off-guard.mjs` writes the real result to `docs/reports/ai-off-guard.json` (committed); `--check` (wired into `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `checks` job, right after the hardcode guard) fails CI when that committed file no longer matches a fresh scan of the code, the same staleness discipline `gen-stage-pages.mjs --check` already holds docs/stages to. ## PR 325

**Support AI agent wiring**

**বাংলায়:** সাপোর্ট চ্যাটের AI খসড়া উত্তর এখন সত্যিকার AI মডেল দিয়েও লেখা হতে পারে — তবে একই তথ্য দিয়ে, কখনো নতুন কিছু বানিয়ে নয়। AI 360 বন্ধ থাকলে, এজেন্ট বন্ধ থাকলে, মাসের খরচের সীমা পার হয়ে গেলে বা কোনো কারণে ব্যর্থ হলে আগের নিয়ম-ভিত্তিক খসড়াই থাকে, কখনো ফাঁকা বা ভুল খসড়া আসে না। কাস্টমারের ফোন নম্বর আর ইমেল AI-কে পাঠানোর আগে মুছে দেওয়া হয়, আর এই প্রথম কোনো সত্যিকার কোড AI 360-এর খরচের সীমা আর হিসাব সত্যিই ব্যবহার করে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Support AI agent wiring — the first real AI-provider job dispatcher (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint B4.15 "grounded answers… must say 'I don't know' rather than invent", C1.1–C1.6, A5.1–A5.6): wires `gyani`'s (the support agent's own) `supportReply` Cost Book job (PR 312) to an actual live model call, the first real caller through every guardrail layer PR 304–324 already built and, until now, never called in production — the master switch and per-agent on/off (PR 304/305), the agent's own model pick (PR 307) with PR 310's data-class routing applied on top (support carries personal data, so a free-capable connection such as OpenRouter is never the effective pick), the monthly spend cap (PR 309), the shared usage ledger (PR 315) and the AI diary (PR 319). **Grounded, not invented:** the model is handed only the facts `@extas/support`'s own rule-based engine (`drafts.ts`/`drafts-pure.ts`, PR 432) already decided (`SupportReplyFacts`) plus the rule-based reply itself (`ruleBasedBody`) — it may only rephrase those words more naturally, never add a fact; `ruleBasedBody` is also this call's own floor, since any failure, timeout, ineligibility or empty answer returns `null` and `supportDraft` ships the rule-based text completely unchanged (C1.4 "AI is additive"). `packages/support/src/drafts.ts` extended (not replaced): new exported `SupportReplyFacts`, `DraftOptions.aiReply?` (an injected callback — keeps `packages/support` free of any `apps/web`/AI dependency) and `SupportDraft.aiUsed`; any thrown error from `aiReply` is swallowed, same as every empty/`null` answer. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/support-dispatch.ts`: `supportAiReplyOption(deps, storeId, refId)` builds that callback — checks `workingNow` (master + per-agent + keep-on-when-off), resolves the agent's routed `effectiveProvider` via PR 310's `routeProvider` (an ineligible/not-ready route returns `null` — the rule-based text is already that same honest fallback), maps the provider to a Cost Book model tier via a new `modelForProvider` helper, pre-checks the monthly cap (`agentCapState`/`wouldExceedCap`, PR 309) before spending anything, calls the live `AiWriter` connection (PR 306) through `createConnections`, and on a real answer records it idempotently (`recordAiUsage`, PR 315, keyed on the conversation + a hash of the rule-based words so a repeat page view of the same still-open question never double-charges) and writes one AI diary line (PR 319, only on the first, non-idempotent write). **PII masking (A5.1–A5.4):** new `maskSupportPii` strips e-mail addresses and Bangladeshi-shaped mobile numbers (any of `01…`/`+8801…`/`8801…`/`008801…`, digit-boundary-guarded so a longer number such as an order id is never half-masked) out of the customer's own words before they ever reach a live provider — this PR's own scoped copy of PR 311's own masking algorithm (that PR is not yet merged to this branch; see PROGRESS.md follow-ups), a deliberate, acknowledged duplication to converge onto PR 311's own file the moment it lands, never a second masking policy. `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer`: `AiWriter` gains `draftSupportReply` (new `AiSupportReplyInput`/`AiSupportReplyDraft` in `shared.ts`); `prompts.ts` gains a grounded support-reply prompt/parser (`FACT_RULE`, zod-validated `{body}` JSON, cut to the caller's own `max.body`); `live.ts`/`mock.ts` wire it through for every provider and the practice adapter (the mock honestly throws when `ruleBasedBody` is itself empty, since there is nothing to rephrase); `anthropic.ts`/`openai-compatible.ts`/`google.ts` and `live.ts`'s own `CompleteResult` now also thread the provider's **real** token usage back (`usage.input_tokens`/`prompt_tokens`/`usageMetadata`), so `recordAiUsage` bills the actual call, not only the Cost Book's static estimate, falling back to that estimate only when a provider's response carries none. Wired into the one real caller, `apps/web/src/app/admin/support/c/[id]/page.tsx`'s own `supportDraft` call, as `opts.aiReply`. **Known limitation, not hidden (follow-up, PROGRESS.md):** a real call is made on every eligible page view of a conversation with an unanswered question, not only once per customer message — a staff member reloading several times while deciding whether to send makes several real (if only once-billed) calls; the owner's own monthly cap is today's real backstop, caching one answer per question is scoped follow-up work. No new visible label: the existing "AI-এর খসড়া" (AI draft) box in the Composer already generically brands any draft as AI's own in both languages, so a real model's rephrasing and the rule-based text look the same to the person reading it; `docs/admin-guide/pages/support/conversation.md`'s own "AI-এর খসড়া" bullet extended with a short note on when it is a real AI 360 call versus the rule-based fallback, linking `ai/control.md` for the spend. 32 new/extended `packages/adapters` tests (`ai-writer.test.ts`/`ai-writer-live.test.ts`, mock + live `draftSupportReply`, real-usage parsing per provider) — 32/32 green; `packages/support`'s `drafts.db.test.ts` extended with 1 new case (AI rephrase success, thrown error, `null` answer, all additive to the rule-based floor); new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/support-dispatch.{test,db.test}.ts` — 3 pure `maskSupportPii` tests (email/phone in every common prefix form, a longer digit string such as an order number never half-masked, more than one occurrence) and 4 DB-integration tests against a stubbed `fetch` (null while AI is off/not ready; the full happy path — masks PII, one real stubbed call, one usage-ledger row + one diary entry, idempotent on a repeat of the same question, a new row for a genuinely new one; the monthly cap stops the call before it is made; any call failure — bad JSON — is swallowed, never thrown). 113/113 admin-ai non-DB tests green overall (was 110/110 before this PR's own 3), 32/32 adapters ai-writer tests green, `packages/support` non-DB suite unaffected (50/50). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings, admin-guide-check clean, lint clean, typecheck clean (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144`). **Verification note:** this session's sandboxed Postgres admin credentials are the same known gap PR 323 already hit — `support-dispatch.db.test.ts` and `drafts.db.test.ts`'s new case self-skip without `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL`, exactly like every other `.db.test.ts` here, and run for real in CI/the merge gate. Fourteenth commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 (not a fresh branch): new files plus a small, additive extension of PR 432's own `drafts.ts`, PR 306's own `ai-writer/{shared,prompts,live,mock,anthropic,openai-compatible,google}.ts`, and the support conversation page/guide — no behaviour of any existing action changed. Carries forward PR 319–324's own note: this branch's base still predates PR 311 landing on `main`; the PR-count/progress figures in this commit are this branch's own running total, for the rebase-merge coordinator to reconcile against `main`'s own count at merge time.
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov

## PR 326

**Product content AI agent**

**বাংলায়:** প্রোডাক্ট এডিট পাতায় এখন ইংরেজি বর্ণনার পাশে "এআই দিয়ে লিখুন" বোতাম — প্রোডাক্টের নিজের নাম, ক্যাটাগরি, কাপড়, রং, সাইজ আর যত্নের তথ্য থেকে Doot একটা খসড়া লিখে দেয়, কখনো নতুন ফিচার বা দাবি বানায় না। সেভ হয় না আপনাআপনি — দেখে নিয়ে তারপর সেভ করতে হয়। AI বন্ধ থাকলে, সংযোগ প্রস্তুত না থাকলে বা মাসের খরচের সীমা শেষ হলে একটা ছোট নোটিশ দেখায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Product content AI agent (S15 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint B4.15 "say only what you were given", C1.1–C1.6, A5.1–A5.6): wires `doot`'s (the product content agent's own) `mktProductDescription` Cost Book job (PR 312) to an actual live model call — the second real caller through the guardrail layers PR 304–324 built and PR 325 first called in production. Unlike Gyani's support job, Doot's own work is `publicDraft` (Blueprint A5.3's own list), so PR 310's `routeProvider` never downgrades a free-capable connection away, and no PII masking is needed — a product's own attributes carry no customer data. **Grounding, not invention:** the model is handed only a product's own already-saved attributes (name, brand, category, fabric, colours, sizes, care text) — never a size, material, feature, price or promise that is not already on the row; `facts` is always built server-side from `@extas/catalogue`'s own `getProduct`, never from anything a client posts, so nothing sent to the route can ever pass as a grounded fact. **Scope decision (no demo screen shows this button yet; CLAUDE.md "think beyond the ask"):** this is a deliberate, explicit action — a new "Write with AI" link beside the English description field on the product edit page (`ProductForm.tsx`) a staff member presses — never a background call on every page view of every description-less product, which would be exactly the unbounded-cost shape PR 325's own known limitation already warns against; each press is its own charge (a fresh `idempotencyKey` per call, not a content hash, since a repeat press is a genuinely new, deliberate ask, unlike support's own per-question idempotency). **Second scope decision:** the fact set stops at the fabric's own plain name, not a fibre-by-fibre composition breakdown — `fabrics.ts`'s own dictionary-keyed `composition` JSON needs a label lookup no caller builds yet (PDP, filters, this one all still want the same shared formatter `fabrics.ts`'s own header comment already names as the eventual single source) — real, scoped follow-up work, not a guess shipped today. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/product-content-dispatch.ts`: `productDescriptionDraft(deps, storeId, productId, locale, facts)` — the same `workingNow`/`routeProvider`/monthly-cap/`recordAiUsage`/`recordDiaryEntry` chain PR 325's `support-dispatch.ts` already uses, returning a typed `{ok:true, body}` or `{ok:false, reason: 'AI_OFF'
  - GitHub pull request #137, 11–12 Nov

## PR 327

**SEO and meta AI agent**

**বাংলায়:** Website › SEO-র "খসড়া দিন" বোতাম এখন AI 360-এর এজেন্ট দূত (Doot) চালু থাকলে, আর তার একটা সত্যিকারের সংযোগ রেডি থাকলে, সত্যিকার AI মডেল দিয়ে প্রোডাক্ট ও ক্যাটাগরি পাতার সার্চ টাইটেল ও বর্ণনা লিখে দেয় — শুধু পাতার নিজের তথ্য থেকে, খরচ ও AI ডায়েরি-তে লেখা থাকে, মাসিক সীমাও মানে। দূত বন্ধ থাকলে, সংযোগ না থাকলে বা সীমা পার হলে সেই পাতার জন্য আগের মতোই অনুশীলনের খসড়া হয় — "খসড়া দিন" চাপলে প্রতিবারই কিছু না কিছু পাওয়া যায়।

**Details**

## PR 328

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Size advice AI agent (S15 reopened, CN-039/CN-044; Blueprint B4.15 "say only what you were given", C1.1–C1.6, A5.1–A5.6): the fourth real AI-provider job dispatcher, wiring a new Cost Book job, `supportSizeAdvice`, to an actual live model call — the same guardrail chain PR 304–324 built and PR 325–327 first called in production (master switch and per-agent on/off, the agent's own routed model pick with PR 310's data-class policy applied, the monthly spend cap, the shared usage ledger, the AI diary). Owned by `gyani` (support, the same agent and the same `personal` data-class routing PR 325's own support reply already uses for this exact chat surface), even though `facts` itself carries no customer data at all — a chart's own numbers, never a name, phone or address — because one chat surface keeps one routing policy, never two. **Grounded, not invented, reusing an existing shape rather than building one (CLAUDE.md "think beyond the ask"; PR 326/327's own precedent):** `facts` is always the caller's own already-decided `Recommendation` from `@extas/catalogue/size-finder`'s own rule engine (PR 58) — the identical engine the product page's own Find My Size runs — carrying the chart's own measure, how much room it gives and whether the chosen size actually covers the need; the model may only explain, in one warm sentence, *why* that size was given, and can never change the size itself. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-support/draft-size-advice.ts`: `draftSizeAdviceFacts(db, resolver, storeId)` — the identical lookup `draft-size.ts`'s own `draftSizeFinder` (PR 432) already runs for the chat's size answer (`productData`, `finderOffered`, `sizeFor`), but keeping every reasoning field instead of only the size key, so no second, independent guess at a size is ever made. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/size-advice-dispatch.ts`: `sizeAdviceNote(deps, storeId, refId, locale, facts)` — the same `workingNow`/`routeProvider`/monthly-cap/`recordAiUsage`/`recordDiaryEntry` chain PR 325–327's own dispatchers already use; `sizeAdviceOption(deps, storeId, refId, facts)` builds the injected callback `@extas/support`'s own `supportDraft` takes. **`packages/support/src/drafts.ts` extended (not replaced):** a second, independent AI slot, `DraftOptions.sizeAdvice?`, called only once `opts.sizeFor` already found a size, with the same product, measures and this draft's own reply language — its answer is folded into the rule-based `filled` text *before* PR 325's own general `aiReply` ever sees it, so the two AI jobs compose the way every AI step here does: strictly additive, each on top of what the step before it already decided; `null` or a thrown error leaves the plain "your size is X" line unchanged either way. Wired into the one real caller, `apps/web/src/app/admin/support/c/[id]/page.tsx`'s own `supportDraft` call, alongside `sizeFor`/`aiReply`. `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer`: `AiWriter` gains `draftSizeAdvice` (new `AiSizeAdviceInput`/`AiSizeAdviceDraft` in `shared.ts`, carrying the recommendation's own measurements only); `prompts.ts` gains a grounded prompt/parser (`SIZE_RULE`, zod-validated `{body}` JSON, never suggesting a different size); `live.ts` wires it through the same generic `complete()` plumbing PR 325 built; `mock.ts` gains `practiceSizeAdvice` (the measurements it was given, in one plain sentence — an honest "largest size, may still feel close" line when the chart does not cover the need) and the mock adapter's own `draftSizeAdvice`. `packages/support`'s `drafts.db.test.ts` extended with 1 new case (the advice sentence added only once a size is found, composing correctly with `aiReply`, never called without `sizeAdvice` offered, any failure or empty answer leaving the plain size line unchanged); new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/size-advice-dispatch.db.test.ts` — 5 DB-integration tests against a stubbed `fetch` (an honest null while AI is off/not ready/capped, writing nothing; the full happy path — one real stubbed call grounded only in the chart's own measurements, one usage-ledger row + one diary entry, idempotent on a repeat of the same answer, a new row for a genuinely different one, the size itself never sent as a question the model could reinterpret; the monthly cap stops the call before it is made; any call failure is swallowed, never thrown; the option itself never calls the real job when the caller's own facts lookup finds no chart). `src/lib/admin-ai`'s own non-DB suite unchanged at 113/113 (the new file is DB-only, `cost-book.test.ts`'s own 60–90 range check still holds at 66), `packages/support` non-DB suite at 50/50 (unchanged; `drafts.db.test.ts`'s new case is DB-only). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings (3232 files), admin-guide-check clean, lint clean, typecheck clean across the whole app (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`), `tools/ai-off-guard.mjs --check` clean against the regenerated report. **Verification note:** this session's sandboxed Postgres admin credentials are the same known gap PR 323/325–327 already hit — `size-advice-dispatch.db.test.ts` and `drafts.db.test.ts`'s new case both self-skip without `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL`, exactly like every other `.db.test.ts` here, and run for real in CI/the merge gate. **Built on a fresh worktree/branch** (`pr-328-size-advice-ai-agent`, based on `pr-327-seo-meta-ai-agent`'s own tip) rather than a further commit on `pr-312-ai-cost-book`/#137 directly, continuing the same stacked-branch shape PR 327 itself used (that lane's shared `ai1-s15` worktree remained mid-rebase-conflict-resolution from a concurrent FIX-lane session): opened as its own GitHub PR with `pr-327-seo-meta-ai-agent` as its base; the FIX lane folds every stacked PR in at merge time. No behaviour of any existing action changed beyond `drafts.ts`'s own additive `sizeAdvice` slot described above.

**Details**

New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/fraud-review-dispatch.ts`: `fraudReviewNote(deps, storeId, alertId, locale, facts)` — the same `workingNow`/`routeProvider`/monthly-cap/`recordAiUsage`/`recordDiaryEntry` chain PR 325–328's own dispatchers already use (idempotency key hashes the card's own words, so a repeat page view of the same still-open review never double-charges, while a re-run after an edit, PR 142, naturally hashes differently and earns its own fresh explanation), plus an early, free "nothing to explain" return when the card itself carries no reasons, matches or history at all; `fraudReviewOption(deps, storeId, alertId, locale)` builds the per-card callback the order page calls. `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer`: `AiWriter` gains `draftFraudReviewNote` (new `AiFraudReviewInput`/`AiFraudReviewDraft` in `shared.ts`, carrying only the card's own already-localized `why`/`matches`/`history` strings — never the decision options); `prompts.ts` gains a grounded prompt/parser (`FRAUD_RULE`, zod-validated `{body}` JSON, forbidding any decision word); `live.ts` wires it through the same generic `complete()` plumbing PR 325 built; `mock.ts` gains `practiceFraudReviewNote` (the reasons, matches and history it was given, joined in plain sentences — no decision word, same honesty as every other practice writer) and the mock adapter's own `draftFraudReviewNote`. **Wired into the one real caller**, `apps/web/src/app/admin/orders/[id]/page.tsx`: `loadOrderDetail` gains an optional 6th parameter, `aiDeps?: AdminDeps` (additive — the one other caller, `orders/confirm/page.tsx`, is untouched and simply gets no AI note); when given, each OPEN review's card builds its `FraudReviewFacts` from the SAME `alertExplainView` call `explain` already uses (computed once, reused twice, never duplicated) and calls `fraudReviewOption`; the result is a new `ReviewCard.aiNote: string
