## PR 333

**Analytics commentary agent — explains the numbers, never invents one**

**বাংলায়:** স্টক পাতায় (Admin › Stock) যেসব SKU কমে গেছে, তার নিচে AI 360 চালু আর জ্ঞানী (Gyani) রেডি থাকলে এখন এক লাইনের ব্যাখ্যা দেখায় — কেন এটা দেখার মতো, শুধু ইতিমধ্যে দেখানো সংখ্যা (কতটা আছে, কত হলে সতর্কতা, কত দিন কম) থেকে, দিনের হিসাব কোডেই করা, AI-কে করতে দেওয়া হয়নি। নতুন কোনো সংখ্যা বানায় না, আর কতটা রিঅর্ডার করবেন বা কার কাছ থেকে, তার সিদ্ধান্তও নেয় না — সেটা সবসময় মানুষ ঠিক করে। আগের তিনটার (৩৩০-৩৩২) মতো শুধু তৈরি করে রাখা নয় — এটা সরাসরি স্টক পাতায় লাগানো আছে। AI 360 বন্ধ, জ্ঞানী বন্ধ, মাসের খরচের সীমা পার, বা কোনো কারণে ব্যর্থ হলে পাতার আসল সংখ্যাগুলো ঠিক আগের মতোই থাকে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Analytics commentary agent — explains the numbers, never invents one (S15 reopened, CN-039/CN-044; Blueprint B4.15 "say only what you were given", C1.1–C1.6, A5.1–A5.6): the ninth real AI-provider job dispatcher, wiring the EXISTING Cost Book job `reportsStockAlert` (PR 312, section "reports", owner `gyani`) to a live model call for the first time — no new Cost Book row, catalogue stays at 66 jobs. Owned by `gyani` (C10's org chart names "reports" as his own remit, the same chief PR 325/328/329/332 already route as `personal`). **Scope decision (CLAUDE.md "think beyond the ask"; the register's own name for this PR, "explains the numbers, never invents one"):** of the `reports` section's own jobs, no real anomaly-detection computation exists anywhere in the codebase yet to ground `reportsAnomalyFlag` on (it would need new statistical infrastructure, a larger scope than wiring one already-existing job), so this PR wires `reportsStockAlert` instead — a real, mature, already-computed number (`@extas/inventory`'s `listLowStock`, PR 202) that the exact same "explain a number honestly, never invent one" brief fits precisely. **Grounded, not invented:** `facts` is never a new figure computed for this PR — it is always the stock page's own already-computed `LowStockItem` fields (product name, SKU, colour, size, available count, threshold) the "Low stock" card (`/admin/stock`, PR 202/205) already shows as plain numbers, plus a whole-day count since the alert opened computed here in code from `LowStockItem.since` rather than left to the model's own date arithmetic. The model is only asked to say, in one short line, why the SKU is worth a look; it is never handed, and the prompt itself (`prompts.ts`'s new `STOCK_ALERT_RULE`) explicitly forbids it from naming, any reorder decision (quantity, supplier, timing) — the fraud/approval queue's own "never a decision" rule (PR 329/330) applies the same way here. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/stock-alert-dispatch.ts` (`stockAlertNote`/`stockAlertOption`, the same `workingNow`/`routeProvider`/monthly-cap/`recordAiUsage`/`recordDiaryEntry` chain PR 325–332 use, idempotency hashing the alert's own current available/threshold numbers so an unchanged alert's repeat page view never double-charges while a changed one earns a fresh line). `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer`: `AiWriter` gains `draftStockAlertNote` (new `AiStockAlertInput`/`AiStockAlertDraft` in `shared.ts`); `prompts.ts` gains `stockAlertPrompt`/`parseStockAlertJson` (`STOCK_ALERT_RULE`, zod-validated `{body}` JSON, forbidding an invented reorder quantity/supplier/cause); `live.ts` wires it through the same generic `complete()` plumbing; `mock.ts` gains `practiceStockAlertNote`. **Wired into a real, already-live, uncontested page (unlike PR 330/331/332's own "built but not yet wired" state):** `/admin/stock`'s own "Low stock" card (S09 · PR 202/205) renders this additive line beside the existing raw numbers for every open alert, server-side, on every page view, using the exact `access.deps`/`aiNotes` Map-of-Promise.all convention PR 330's own growth page already established; new i18n key `stock.low.aiNote.label` added to `admin-stock.en.json`/`admin-stock.bn.json` (English/Bengali), and `docs/admin-guide/pages/products/stock.md`'s own "প্রতিটা বোতাম আর ঘরের মানে" section gained one new bullet explaining it, per CLAUDE.md's "every PR that adds or changes an admin screen updates its guide in the same PR". This page sits outside the S23 marketing/studio files and the ERP lane's own `/admin/orders`/`/admin/products` "design" variants three other lanes are mid-way through rewriting, so there is nothing here to collide with. 3 new `packages/adapters` tests (`ai-writer.test.ts`'s practice stock alert note incl. the "no colour/size" case + `ai-writer-live.test.ts`'s usage-threading `draftStockAlertNote` cases); new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/stock-alert-dispatch.db.test.ts` — 6 DB-integration tests against a stubbed `fetch` (an honest null while AI 360 is off/the agent is paused/no connection is ready; a further honest null, with no lookup at all, when the alert has no product name or SKU; the full happy path grounded only in the alert's own already-computed numbers, confirmed the day count reached the provider pre-computed and never a reorder decision was handed to it, one usage-ledger row + one diary entry, idempotent on a repeat view at the same numbers, a new row once the available count changes; the monthly cap stops the call before it is made; any call failure is swallowed, never thrown; `stockAlertOption` threads the given facts straight through with no second lookup). ## PR 334

**System Q&A agent — the owner asks the system how it works**

**বাংলায়:** প্রতিটা অ্যাডমিন পাতার গাইড প্যানেলে এখন একটা প্রশ্ন জিজ্ঞাসা করার বক্স আছে — প্রশ্ন লিখে "জিজ্ঞাসা করুন" চাপলে AI 360 চালু আর প্রহরী (Prohori) রেডি থাকলে উত্তর আসে, কিন্তু শুধু ওই পাতার নিজের গাইডের লেখা থেকে (কাটা পড়া পুরনো লেখা উত্তরে কখনো যায় না) — নতুন কোনো তথ্য বানায় না। অ্যাডমিনের ভাষা (English/বাং) অনুযায়ী উত্তর আসে, বাংলা গাইডের অনুবাদ হিসেবে, আলাদা একটা গাইড বানিয়ে না। AI 360 বন্ধ, প্রহরী বন্ধ, বা কোনো সংযোগ রেডি না থাকলে সৎভাবে বলে দেয় উত্তর দেওয়া যাচ্ছে না।

Owned by `prohori` (routed `business`, C10's org chart). **Scope decision (one job per dispatcher, PR 325–333's own precedent; CN-026's own wording, "the page-aware AI helper explains... and takes commands through the approval queue"):** wires only `adminGuideAnswer` — one typed question about the page the owner is already on, answered from that page's own guide text; ## PR 335

**Competitor Teardown agent — journey walker**

**বাংলায়:** প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীর একটা পাতার ঠিকানা (ক্যাটাগরি, প্রোডাক্ট, কার্ট বা চেকআউট — বড়জোর ৪টা ধাপ) দিলে, পুরনো "লিংক থেকে আনুন" ফিচারের একই নিরাপদ পাতা-পড়ার ব্যবস্থা দিয়ে পাতাটা পড়ে, আর AI 360 চালু আর জ্ঞানী (Gyani) রেডি থাকলে প্রতিটা পড়া-যাওয়া ধাপের জন্য এক লাইনের সৎ পর্যবেক্ষণ লেখে — লে-আউট, আস্থার চিহ্ন, অফার, চেকআউটের ঘর — কিন্তু কখনো দাম বা কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত লেখে না, আর পাতার লেখা হুবহু কপি করে না। এখনো সত্যিকারের ব্রাউজার চালানোর ব্যবস্থা নেই, তাই সাইজ/রং বাছা বা "কার্টে যোগ করুন"-এ ক্লিক করা হয় না — তাই সত্যিকারের অর্ডার, লগইন বা পেমেন্ট দেওয়ার কোনো সুযোগই নেই। স্ক্রিনশট এখনো নেওয়া হয় না। কোনো পাতা পড়া না গেলে তা সৎভাবে জানিয়ে দেয়, আর বাকি ধাপগুলো চলতে থাকে। এখনো কোনো অ্যাডমিন পাতায় এটা দেখা যায় না — তুলনার রিপোর্ট (পরের PR) এলে দেখানোর মতো কিছু থাকবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Competitor Teardown agent — journey walker (S15 reopened, CN-039/CN-044; Blueprint B8 "Competitor Teardown agent", B8.1, B8.2, B8.4; B4.15 "say only what you were given"): the eleventh real AI-provider job dispatcher, and the first slice of Blueprint B8.4's own +3-PR split ("journey walker · comparison and report engine · saved competitors, scheduling and change alerts" — PR 336/337 build the other two). Wires a NEW Cost Book job, `reportsCompetitorJourneyStep` (catalogue 66 → 67 jobs) — PR 312's own `reportsCompetitorScan` is "reads one competitor's public price for the same or similar item" only, a much smaller job whose own 400/150-token estimate would misstate the cost of reading a whole page's text, so it is not reused. Owned by `gyani` (C10's org chart; the same chief PR 325/328–330/332/333 already route as `personal`) — what this job reads is a competitor's own PUBLIC page, no customer/owner/order data at all, but one chief keeps one routing policy, never a second one for the same remit (PR 333's own precedent). **Grounded, not invented:** each step's observation is grounded only in that one page's own already-fetched HTML, reduced to plain text by `@extas/catalogue`'s own `plainText` (PR 33's helper, reused, not rebuilt) and cut to a 6000-character ceiling; the prompt (`prompts.ts`'s new `COMPETITOR_STEP_RULE`) forbids inventing anything the text does not show, forbids naming a price or a decision, and forbids copying the page's own wording or code verbatim (Blueprint B8.2: "ideas and patterns are studied; wording and design are not lifted"). **Honest limits, stated plainly rather than worked around (Blueprint B8.2's own three "will not" rules):** no real browser automation exists here (no headless-browser/rendering key, no JS execution) — each "step" is one plain http(s) GET of a URL the caller already names, read through the SAME SSRF-safe page reader connection PR 33 already built (`pageReader`, Keys & connections), never a second, duplicate network reader; selecting a variant/size and pressing "add to cart" are interactive actions a plain GET cannot perform, so the walk only reaches pages already reachable by an address in hand — it never clicks, never fills or submits a form, and (automatically, since nothing is ever POSTed to a third-party site) never places a real order, never logs in and never enters a payment flow, so B8.2's limits hold by construction; screenshots are not built (needs a real headless-browser/rendering provider, no key exists yet — the same shape PR 331/332 already left open for their own missing providers); a step the reader cannot read at all (an SSRF-blocked address, a timeout, a site error, a non-HTML answer) is reported plainly as `blocked: true` with the reason, never retried, and the walk continues to the next step. Each step's own real read (title, or why it could not be read) always happens and is always returned; only the short AI-written observation on top is additive and may honestly be `null` (AI off/paused, no ready connection, the monthly cap, a malformed answer) — the same additive shape every dispatcher before this one uses (C1.4). New `POST /api/admin/reports/competitor-walk` (`competitor-journey-api.ts` + route, `reports.read`, up to 4 `{label, url}` steps from the request body — never a product id or anything else that could pass as a grounded fact). **Deliberately NOT wired into any admin page in this PR** (the same honest gap PR 331/332 already left open for their own missing callers): Blueprint B8.4's own page ("paste a link, pick what to compare, get the report") needs PR 336's comparison/report engine to have something worth showing — a side-by-side table against EXTAS — so no page exists yet to put one on; the dispatcher and its API route are complete, tested and reachable today by any `reports.read` caller. 2 new `packages/adapters` tests (`ai-writer.test.ts`'s practice competitor-step draft + `ai-writer-live.test.ts`'s usage-threading `draftCompetitorStep` cases) — 382/382 → package total unchanged in file count, 4 new cases added; new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/competitor-journey-dispatch.db.test.ts` — 7 DB-integration tests (every step's own real read always happens even with AI 360 off, the title and text come back, the note stays an honest null; a step whose own address cannot even be read (a non-http(s) scheme) is reported `blocked: true` with a reason, never retried, and the walk still returns every other step; the walk is bounded to at most 4 steps even when given 6; the full happy path grounded only in that step's own page text, confirmed the model was never asked to decide "price/skip/adopt", one usage-ledger row + one diary entry, idempotent on a repeat of the same unchanged page, a genuinely different page its own fresh row; the monthly cap stops a call before it is made; any call failure is swallowed, never thrown, and the step's own real read still comes back). ## PR 336

**Competitor comparison and report engine**

**বাংলায়:** প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীর হাঁটা (আগের PR) আর আমাদের নিজের মিলে-যাওয়া পাতাগুলো পাশাপাশি রেখে একটা তুলনার টেবিল বানায় — কোন ধাপ কার সঙ্গে মিলল সেটা নিজেই (কোনো এআই অনুমান ছাড়া) ঠিক করে, আর আমাদের কোনো মিলে-যাওয়া পাতা না থাকলে সেটা সৎভাবে জানিয়ে দেয়, বানিয়ে বলে না। AI 360 চালু থাকলে প্রতিটা ধাপের জন্য রায় দেয় — ওরা ভালো / আমরা ভালো / কোনোটাই জরুরি না — আর একটা সাজেশন (রাখো / বদলে রাখো / বাদ দাও) এবং কারণ, কখনো দাম বা পলিসি নিয়ে সিদ্ধান্ত নেয় না। সাথে যদি দুই পক্ষের কোনোটাই ভালো না হয় সেটাও সৎভাবে বলে দেয়, আর EXTAS যা এমনিতেই ভালো করছে তার একটা ছোট তালিকা দেয়। এখনো কোনো অ্যাডমিন পাতায় দেখা যায় না — পরের PR-এ সেভ-করা প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীদের তালিকা এলে এই রিপোর্ট দেখানোর মতো একটা জায়গা পাবে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Competitor comparison and report engine (S15 reopened, CN-039/CN-044; Blueprint B8 "Competitor Teardown agent", B8.3, B8.4; B4.15 "say only what you were given"): the twelfth real AI-provider job dispatcher, and the second slice of Blueprint B8.4's own +3-PR split (the journey walker is PR 335; saved/scheduled competitors are PR 337). Builds Blueprint B8.3's own report, in order: (1) their journey step by step — PR 335's own walk result, unchanged; (2) **a side-by-side table against our own matching pages** — a deterministic pairing by label (case/whitespace-insensitive), pure code (`pairCompetitorSteps`), never the model's own guess, with a step that has no matching page of ours marked honestly `ours: null`, never invented; (3)-(5) each row's own **verdict** (they_better / we_better / neither_matters), **recommendation** (Pick / Pick with changes / Skip) and reason, plus Claude's own view when neither side's approach is good (B8.3.5, "it is fine to say none of it is worth taking"); (6) **a short list of what EXTAS already does better** (B8.3.6), kept only when grounded in a note the caller actually gave. Wires a NEW Cost Book job, `reportsCompetitorComparison` (catalogue 67 → 68 jobs; 3000/1200-token estimate, `TEXT_LARGE`/Opus tier, matching `reportsExecSummary`/`orderFraudJudge`'s own "real judgement" tier) — not a reuse of PR 335's own `reportsCompetitorJourneyStep`, which is a single-page observation at a different, smaller cost shape. Owned by `gyani` (same routing policy as PR 335's own job — PR 333's precedent: one chief, one routing policy, never a second one for the same remit). **Grounded, not invented:** the model only ever sees each row's own already-grounded facts — the title, the `blocked` flag, and the short observation PR 335's own job already wrote for it — never raw page text a second time, never a price; the prompt (`prompts.ts`'s new `COMPETITOR_COMPARISON_RULE`) forbids judging a step it was not given, forbids crediting "ours" with a detail neither side's own note mentioned, and forbids deciding a price, a discount or any policy (a UI/content pattern only). The parser (`parseCompetitorComparisonJson`) never trusts the model to have judged only the steps it was given: it keeps only the rows whose label matches one of ours, in our own order, and silently drops a row for any other label — the same defensive-never-trust-the-model discipline PR 335's own step-label grounding already set. **Honest, additive shape (C1.4), one layer further than before:** the deterministic side-by-side table (parts 1-2) needs no AI call at all and is **always** returned, even with AI 360 off; only the judgement on top (parts 3-6) is additive and may honestly be `null`/empty for every row (AI off/paused, no ready connection, the monthly cap, a malformed answer, or every answered label being one it was not given). New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/competitor-comparison-dispatch.ts` (`pairCompetitorSteps` — pure, exported for its own unit test; `buildCompetitorComparisonReport` — the same `workingNow`/`routeProvider`/monthly-cap/`recordAiUsage`/`recordDiaryEntry` chain PR 325–335 use, once per report rather than once per step; idempotency key hashes the report id + the paired table's own current facts, so an unchanged walk's repeat judgement never double-charges while a changed walk earns a fresh row). `packages/adapters/src/ai-writer`: `AiWriter` gains `draftCompetitorComparison` (new `AiCompetitorComparisonInput`/`AiCompetitorComparisonDraft` in `shared.ts`, with `verdict`/`recommendation` as typed enums); `prompts.ts` gains `competitorComparisonPrompt`/`parseCompetitorComparisonJson` (`COMPETITOR_COMPARISON_RULE`, zod-validated `{rows, claudesView, extasAdvantages}` JSON, `z.array(z.object(...))` the same shape PR 293's own `campaignAnswer` already uses for a multi-item answer); `live.ts` wires it through the same generic `complete()` plumbing; `mock.ts` gains `practiceCompetitorComparison` (one honest `neither_matters`/`pick_with_changes` line per given step, naming only the step's own label; no `claudesView`, no `extasAdvantages` until a real provider is connected — inventing either here would be exactly the guess this agent exists to avoid). New `POST /api/admin/reports/competitor-comparison` (`competitor-comparison-api.ts` + route, `reports.read`, `{theirSteps, ourSteps}` — walks both through PR 335's own `walkCompetitorJourney`, never a different reader or limit, then builds the report). **Deliberately NOT wired into any admin page in this PR** (the same honest gap PR 331/332/335 already left open for their own missing callers): Blueprint B8.4's own page ("paste a link, pick what to compare, get the report") is PR 337's own saved/scheduled-competitors slice; the dispatcher and its API route are complete, tested and reachable today by any `reports.read` caller, and this is the first PR where the report actually has something worth showing on a future page. 4 new `packages/adapters` tests (`ai-writer.test.ts`'s practice comparison draft, in-order + empty-steps cases; `ai-writer-live.test.ts`'s label-filtering/ordering + no-usable-row cases) — package total 394/394, up from 390; new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/competitor-comparison-dispatch.db.test.ts` — 7 DB-integration tests (the pure pairing function's own unit case; the deterministic table always returns even with AI 360 off, judgement fields an honest null, 0 ledger rows; a blocked step is still judged on the competitor side alone once a provider is ready; the full happy path — one usage-ledger row + one diary entry, idempotent on a repeat of the same unchanged table, a genuinely different table its own fresh row; the monthly cap stops a call before it is made; a bad answer or an answer that only judges an invented label is swallowed, never thrown, the table still comes back; a report with no matching page of ours at all still returns every given step, `ours: null`, never invented). Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings (3269 files — this PR's own first draft of `COMPETITOR_COMPARISON_RULE` named "EXTAS" directly in a prompt string and was caught and fixed to "our own/we" before this row was written, since the store's own name is owner data, never a hardcoded brand word in source), ai-off-guard `--check` clean (7/7 checks, 30/68 jobs, `docs/reports/ai-off-guard.json` regenerated and committed — the "reports" check's own `jobKeyPrefixes: ["reports"]` automatically covers the new job), admin-guide-check clean (no admin page added or changed by this PR), lint clean (adapters + web), typecheck clean (adapters + whole web app, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` — both packages still OOM at the default heap in this sandbox, the same environment limit PR 335 already noted). **Verification note:** this session's sandboxed Postgres admin credentials are the same known gap PR 323/325–335 already hit; the DB test self-skips without `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL` and runs for real in CI/the merge gate. **Built on the same stacked branch as PR 328–335** (`.claude/worktrees/ai1-s15-pr328`, branch `pr-328-size-advice-ai-agent`) — a further commit on that same branch; GitHub PR #177 (base `pr-327-seo-meta-ai-agent`) updated in place, still marked not for merge, for the FIX lane to fold in at merge time alongside every other stacked PR in this S15 chain. **Still noted for the FIX lane/owner, unchanged since PR 335:** CLAUDE.md's CN-045 "Batch-PR CI gating" (batch branches, 12 Nov) remains unadopted by this already-mid-flight stacked chain — no batch branch exists yet on origin as of this PR either; kept the existing one-branch/one-umbrella-PR convention again, still flagged for a human/coordinator call on migrating this lane rather than restructuring it unilaterally mid-chain. ## PR 337

**Saved competitors, scheduling, and change alerts**

**বাংলায়:** প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীদের একটা সেভ করা তালিকা রাখা যায় — নাম, পাতার ঠিকানা, আর চাইলে সাপ্তাহিক/মাসিক পুনঃচেক পছন্দ; যোগ, এডিট, আর্কাইভ, ফিরিয়ে আনা — কিছুই পুরোপুরি মুছে যায় না। "এখন চালান" চাপলে পাতাটা আবার পড়ে, আগের রিপোর্টের সঙ্গে তুলনা করে (কোডেই, কোনো এআই অনুমান ছাড়া) দেখে কিছু বদলেছে কিনা — শিরোনাম, পাতা পড়া যাচ্ছে কিনা, বা এআই-র পর্যবেক্ষণ — আর সত্যিকারের বদল পেলে একটা সৎ ডায়েরি লাইন লেখে। এখনো কোনো রোবট নিজে থেকে সময় মতো চালায় না (সেটা এখনো শুধু একটা প্রিভিউ, PR ৩০৮-এর মতোই) আর এখনো কোনো অ্যাডমিন পাতায় দেখা যায় না — ব্যাকএন্ড এখন সম্পূর্ণ, পাতাটা পরের কাজ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Saved competitors, scheduling and change alerts (S15 reopened, CN-039/CN-044; Blueprint B8 "Competitor Teardown agent", B8.4, B8.10 item 14): the third and final slice of B8.4's own +3-PR split (journey walker PR 335; comparison/report engine PR 336). Uses the `Competitor`/`CompetitorReport` models the schema's own owner already reserved for exactly PR 335–337 (`@stage S15 · PR 335–337` in `schema.prisma`) — **no schema edit in this PR.** Each saved row is one studied page over time (the schema's own `url: String`, a single address — a deliberate simplification the schema's own shape already encodes, B8.4's own "a saved list of competitors" rather than B8.1's richer one-off four-stage walk). New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/competitor-list.ts`: full CRUD (`listCompetitors`/`createCompetitor`/`updateCompetitor`/`setCompetitorArchived`, nothing ever deleted — CLAUDE.md rule 3), `readableUrl` (PR 33's own http(s)-only check, reused) refusing a bad address at SAVE time, never only discovered on the first run. New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/competitor-recheck.ts`: `recheckCompetitor` walks the saved page again through PR 335's own `walkCompetitorJourney` (the SAME reader, never a second implementation), saves a new `CompetitorReport`, and `diffCompetitorFindings` — **pure, deterministic code, never an AI guess** (PR 336's own "pure code decides the match" discipline) — compares the new read's title/blocked-flag/grounded-note against the competitor's own most recent prior report; a genuine change past the first run is the diary's own honest Bengali line (`recordDiaryEntry`, `refType: 'CompetitorChange'`) — Blueprint B8.4's own "tells the owner when a competitor changes something." New `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/competitor-schedule.ts` (split out so `competitor-list.ts`/`competitor-recheck.ts` need not import each other, the same reason `errors.ts` sits below `control-room.ts`/`model-picks.ts`): `nextDueAt`/`isDue`, a `weekly`/`monthly`/`null` preview (B8.10's own still-open owner question, "weekly or monthly") of when a recheck would next be due. **Honest, structural gap, stated plainly rather than worked around:** no automatic schedule runs yet — `nextDueAt` is a preview only, the EXACT same shape PR 308 already shipped for `AiAgent.schedule` ("no AI job runner reads a schedule yet"). The reason is structural, not an oversight: every AI 360 dispatcher PR 304–336 built (the cost book, usage ledger, spend cap, data-class routing, diary) lives under `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai`, reached only from this Next.js app's own API routes — never from `@extas/jobs`, the separate background-worker process that runs every OTHER stage's own scheduled sweep (the daily audience refresh, the ad-spend import, the money report). A real automatic re-check needs either a cross-process trigger (the worker calling back into this app over HTTP) or moving the whole AI 360 dispatch layer into a shared package — both cross-cutting infrastructure decisions touching all 12 dispatchers already merged in this chain, not one PR's call to make unilaterally. "Run now" always works today, with no schedule needed at all. New permission `reports.competitors.write` (`packages/auth/src/catalogue.ts`, English+Bengali labels; seeing the list/reports stays under the existing `reports.read`) — the owner role holds it automatically, as every permission. ## PR 338

**Site-wide analytics event layer**

**বাংলায়:** দোকানের নিজের অ্যানালিটিক্স এখন শুরু হলো — কাস্টমার কী করছে (কী খুঁজছে, হোয়াটসঅ্যাপে ক্লিক, ব্যাগে যোগ/বাদ, কেনা, রং/সাইজ চার্ট দেখা, উইশলিস্টে রাখা) নিজেদের ডেটাবেজেই জমা হয় — কোনো বাইরের সার্ভিসের ওপর নির্ভর না করে। প্রতিটা পাতায় একটা নিঃশব্দ বিকন বসানো হলো, আর ব্যাগ/চেকআউট থেকে সত্যিকারের দুটো ঘটনা (ব্যাগে যোগ, কেনা) এখনই রেকর্ড হচ্ছে। বাকি ঘটনাগুলো পরের ধাপে (ফানেল রিপোর্ট) যোগ হবে। সাথে একটা ছোট বাগ ফিক্স হলো — AI Cost Book পাতা ক্র্যাশ করছিল, সেটা ঠিক হয়েছে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Site-wide analytics event layer (S15 reopened, CN-039/CN-044; Blueprint D5 "Analytics — Locked", D5.3, D5's own V2 note): the first of the +4-PR run that closes S15 (339 per-page funnels · 340 the report section · 341 digests), on the same `AnalyticsEvent`/`Funnel`/`ReportDigest` models the schema's own owner already reserved (`@stage S15 · PR 338/339/340,341,540` in `schema.prisma`) — **no schema edit in this PR.** D5.3's own build order, "deterministic event capture first… nothing here is an AI guess," so this PR is pure capture, never interpretation (PR 333's commentary agent, already built, is the only reader that explains; this layer only stores). New `@extas/analytics` package: `events.ts` — the owner's own event catalogue (`ANALYTICS_EVENT_NAMES`, 19 names: the D5.1 starting set plus the owner's own V2 list — search terms; WhatsApp clicks by page *and* button; add-to-bag → purchased; direct purchase; removed, re-added, new adds; adds from an offer/combo/set; "All N colours" taps; Size chart taps; wishlist saves) and `normalizeAnalyticsEvent` — deterministic, lenient shaping (an unknown name, an over-long string, an unreadable prop or a future/far-past clock are each handled on their own, never a wholesale refusal) matching D5.3's own "tracking can fail, the shop cannot"; `record.ts` — `recordAnalyticsEvent` writes the one row, refusing (returning `null`, never throwing) an event name outside the catalogue. New public beacon `POST /api/shop/analytics` (`apps/web/src/lib/analytics/ingest.ts`): same-site only, size-capped, mints the shop's own existing visitor cookie (`BAG_COOKIE`, PR 105's own `__Host-extas_bag` — the same id the bag, wishlist and orders already read, never a second cookie of its own) on a page's first beacon call; a signed-in customer's id and `isLoggedIn` come from the shop's own session (`customerOfRequest`), never the browser's say-so; answers 204 (or quietly nothing) for every refusal — a disabled switch, a bad body, an unknown event — so a shopper's page is never held up or shown an error. New client `components/shop/AnalyticsBeacon.tsx`, wired into the shop layout beside (never instead of) PR 257's own ad-tracking `TrackingBeacon` — the two feed different readers (ad platforms there, the owner's own Analytics section here) and the new one has no outside dependency, so it runs by default; fires one `page_view` per page with the page's own kind (`pageKindOf`, PR 600's existing classifier, reused). Two real server-side write paths wired in the same pattern PR 257 already set (`trackAddToBag`/`trackPurchase`, a sibling call beside each): `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/shop-hooks.ts`'s `recordAddToBagAnalytics` (bag-api.ts, after a real add) and `recordPurchaseAnalytics` (checkout-api.ts, after an order is saved) — both quiet, both gated by the new master switch. New setting `analytics.events` (`packages/settings/src/registry-analytics.ts`, registry v288, English+Bengali labels): one on/off switch, **on** as it ships — unlike `ads.tracking` there is no platform key to wait for (CLAUDE.md rule 2 is about integrations; this has none), and PR 339–341's own reports need real data from day one; turning it off only stops new events, nothing already saved is ever removed (CLAUDE.md rule 3). **Deliberately scoped to the layer plus a representative, real wiring, not every one of the owner's 19 events:** D5.1's own "the list below is the starting set, not the limit" and the +4-PR split (339 is explicitly "per-page funnels built on that layer") mean the funnels PR is the natural place to wire whichever further events a given funnel needs, rather than wiring all 19 speculatively here with no reader yet to prove them against; the catalogue already names all 19, so a future wiring adds a call, never a schema or catalogue change. 16 new pure tests (`events.test.ts`: the catalogue, `normalizeAnalyticsEvent`'s refusals and lenient shaping, `clampProps`, `clampOccurredAt`); new `record.db.test.ts` (5), `ingest.db.test.ts` (7) and `shop-hooks.db.test.ts` (5) — DB-integration tests (a minimal event stored with every optional field null; the richer fields kept; an unknown name refused, nothing written; store-scoped; a far-future clock clamped; the beacon mints/reuses the visitor cookie; cross-site refused; the master switch off stops writes but still mints the cookie; a GET refused; the bag-add and purchase hooks store the right props and skip without a visitor cookie or with the switch off). **Found and fixed in passing, same branch, its own separate commit (`82d9a01f`, "PR 312 fix"):** the CI smoke test's own PR #177 run caught `/admin/ai/cost-book` 500ing — three of its Client Components (PR 312/314/316) were receiving a `money` formatter *function* as a prop from the server page, which Next.js refuses across the Server→Client boundary; fixed by pre-formatting the static per-model costs server-side and passing the live-calculated ones' plain, serializable `Money` config instead — unrelated to this PR's own scope, fixed because it was found, not left for the owner to hit. Gates: hardcode guard 0 findings (3278 files), ai-off-guard `--check` clean (unchanged — no new Cost Book job), admin-guide-check clean (no admin page added — the Analytics section's own page is PR 340's job), lint clean (web + settings + the new `@extas/analytics`), typecheck clean (web `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`; settings and analytics on default heap). **Verification note:** the same sandboxed-Postgres gap PR 323 onward already hit; every new DB test self-skips without `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL` and runs for real in CI. **Built on the same stacked branch as PR 328–337** (`.claude/worktrees/ai1-s15-pr328`, branch `pr-328-size-advice-ai-agent`); GitHub PR #177 updated in place, still marked not for merge. **Still noted for the FIX lane/owner, unchanged since PR 335–337:** CLAUDE.md's CN-045 (batch-branch CI gating) remains unadopted by this already-mid-flight stacked chain. No behaviour of any existing action changed for a store with analytics off (the master switch) — purely additive. **Next:** the register's own next unbuilt S15 row (PR 339, per-page funnels built on this layer).
- **What it does (original scope):** **Site-wide analytics event layer**

  - **19 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (round 15, no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-653): **PR 338 / 339 (analytics event layer + funnels)** — the owner's event list is now part of the layer's definition: search terms; WhatsApp clicks by page *and* by button; add-to-bag → purchased; direct purchase (Order Now); removed from bag, re-added, new adds; adds that came from an offer/combo/set; "All N colours" taps; Size chart taps; wishlist saves; logged-in vs guest on every event. Every event carries page type, product/category, and source button so each part can be read on its own.

## PR 577

**Agent 360° profiles — each of the six fixed agents (প্রহরী Prohori, ভান্ডারী Bhandari, সওদাগর Sawdagor, শিল্পী Shilpi, দূত Doot, জ্ঞানী …**

**বাংলায়:** প্রতিটা এজেন্টের নিজের ৩৬০° প্রোফাইল পাতা হলো — সাতজনের টিম তালিকা থেকে চেপে খোলে। ভূমিকা, কাজ, পরিকল্পনা আর স্কিল এজেন্টের নিজের ফাইল থেকে পড়া; মালিক চাইলে ছবি-পরিচিতি বদলাতে, পুরস্কার দিতে আর কাজ দিতে পারেন। ওয়ার্ক লগ সৎভাবে খালি যতদিন লাইভ ড্যাশবোর্ড না আসে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: One agent's 360° profile (C10.4; no migration — `AiAgent.bio`/`photoAssetRef`/`joinedOn`/`verified` and `AiAgentAssignment` already in the full S00 schema; permissions `ai.read`/`ai.control` reused): new `apps/web/src/lib/admin-ai/agent-profile.ts` — AI › Agents (`/admin/agents`, Lumen): a team grid of the seven fixed agents (photo/initial, name, role, open/done assignment counts, the verified star), each linking to its own `/admin/agents/:key` 360° profile — role, owns, never-touches and current plan read straight from the agent's own `docs/agents/<key>.md` (parsed at request time, never copied into code, the same two-root `guideDir()` fallback the help-guide reader uses), skills it has and is learning the same way, its real work log (`AiWorkLog`, honestly empty until a live job-runner writes to it), rewards (`AiWorkLog` rows tagged `outcome: 'reward'`) and assignments (`AiAgentAssignment`, open/done, idempotent complete). `ai.control` adds an editor for the owner's own identity fields (bio ≤600 chars, a pasted photo URL, joining date, the verified star) plus "give a reward" and "assign a task" forms, each a plain `POST`/`PATCH` to `/api/admin/agents[/:key]`, audited and idempotent on a double tap. The agent's own fixed name/role/code stay structural identity, never owner-editable from this page (deviates from the Blueprint's literal "fully editable" wording to honour the stronger existing commitment every other PR 304–310 screen already relies on — documented in the module's header). Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/agents.md` and `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/agent-profile.md`; smoke and device-gate lists updated (`/admin/agents`, `/admin/agents/gyani`).

## PR 578

**Agent appraisal reports — daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reports per agent, written like an employee's: what it did, what it left …**

**বাংলায়:** AI › এজেন্টের রিপোর্ট পাতা হলো: প্রতিটা এজেন্টের দৈনিক/সাপ্তাহিক/মাসিক/বাৎসরিক রিপোর্ট, তার নিজের কাজের লগ থেকে চাপলেই তৈরি — কয়টা কাজ, নিজে বনাম মালিক ধরা বাগ, পুরস্কার, খরচ, প্রথমবারেই ঠিক হওয়ার হার। এখনো কোনো জব-রানার না থাকায় সংখ্যা সৎভাবে শূন্য।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: Agent reports (C10.4; no migration — `AiAppraisal` already in the full S00 schema, tagged for this exact PR; permissions `ai.read`, `ai.control`): AI › Agent reports (`/admin/ai/reports`, new tab, Lumen pattern): daily/weekly/monthly/yearly reports per agent, generated on demand from its own `AiWorkLog` (tasks and outcomes — two new values, `bug_self`/`bug_owner`, beyond PR 577's own `reward`) and `AiUsageLedger` (cost); KPI tiles (tasks done, bugs found by itself vs. by the owner, rewards, cost, first-time-right rate) plus the full Bengali report text, or an honest "no report yet" state; history of the last 12 generated reports per period, newest first. Periods are rolling windows ending now (1/7/30/365 days), the same shape PR 303's Customers report and PR 338's Shopper analytics already use, not literal calendar weeks/months/years. Seeing the page needs `ai.read`; "Generate now" needs `ai.control` (idempotent — regenerating the same agent/period/day refreshes the one row, never piles up duplicates). With no job runner writing real work yet, every KPI honestly reads zero/null (CLAUDE.md "never invent a number"); the yearly report's competency ratings and curriculum levels say plainly "not yet filled" rather than being invented, pending PR 579 (curriculum) and the owner's own rating screen. Scheduled Telegram/e-mail sends stay a later PR on this same table. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/ai/reports.md`.
- **What it does (original scope):** **Agent appraisal reports** — daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reports per agent, written like an employee's: what it did, what it left undone and why, what it learned, its history, KPIs against targets (first-time-right, bugs it found vs the owner found, rework, cost), and a yearly appraisal in the multinational style (goals, ratings, development plan). On demand or on schedule (Telegram / email).

A level stays `notStarted` by default on every agent and can only be advanced by the owner's own hand until the sandbox exam runner (PR 322) is merged — the same honest, manual-until-automated gap every other PR in this stage (305/307/308/309) shipped ahead of its own job-runner. - **What it does (original scope):** **Model auto-suggest with free-model qualification** — for every agent job the system suggests a model with its reason; the owner accepts or changes it. Free models are in the pool and are **qualified**: each job type has a quality test set, every candidate (paid or free) is scored, and the cheapest model that passes the job's quality bar is suggested — cost falls only when quality holds, never by lowering it. ## PR 583

**Chief agent — জ্ঞানী Gyani as virtual CEO (প্রধান এজেন্ট), chain of command**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

Asked "why are sales down this month / this week?", "why was today's courier entry wrong?", "why is this bug on the category page?", Gyani investigates across every section (orders, ads, stock, delivery, site errors, the agents' work logs), names **which agent's area caused it, with evidence**, assigns the fix to that agent, tracks it to done and reports back. Broad knowledge beyond its own stages (business, finance, operations, marketing, tech) — curriculum adds an executive/general-management track. Second only to the owner. **Free to do:** research, reports, analysis, assigning and reviewing work, warnings to agents (written into their appraisals PR 578). **Only with the owner's approval:** any money movement or refund, any COD amount change on an order, price or discount changes, ad budget increases, blocking anyone, deleting data, anything that cannot be undone. The permission list is a dashboard setting the owner edits; enforced by code. Lives in S15 AI 360 (org chart, open investigations, who-owns-what).

## PR 584

**Telegram identity and command routing**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Telegram identity and command routing.** All agents share the owner's one Telegram bot. Every message starts with the sender's identity — photo/emoji, name, Bengali name, **employee code**, role (e.g. "🏹 Tirondaj তীরন্দাজ · A360-07 · Ads") — so the owner always knows who sent it. When the owner writes a command naming an agent or its code ("A360-07 budget report", "@Bhandari courier entry check"), the task is **assigned to that agent automatically**, appears on its profile as an assignment, and the agent replies in the same thread when done. No name → goes to the chief (Gyani), who routes it. Approvals come back as buttons (Approve / Reject / Ask why). Also visible in the dashboard.

## PR 585

**Continuous learning engine — Tirondaj (ads) and Doot (SEO/marketing) are the two power agents**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “AI কন্ট্রোল রুম” ধাপের অংশ: সব AI এজেন্টের সুইচ, খরচের সীমা, অনুমতি আর রিপোর্ট এক জায়গায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Continuous learning engine — Tirondaj (ads) and Doot (SEO/marketing) are the two power agents.** They learn without stopping from: official docs (Meta, Google, TikTok, Search Central), the big practitioner blogs on SEO and paid ads, Reddit communities (PPC, Facebook ads, SEO, e-commerce), YouTube tutorials incl. South-Asian e-commerce channels (read through transcripts), LinkedIn and Facebook posts of known specialists (where readable; through a paid tool if needed), case studies. **When stuck:** research all sources → solve → the solution becomes a skill in its basket. **Quality gate (no shortcut learning):** a tip becomes a skill only after it is checked against the official docs or two independent good sources, tested in a sandbox or small live test, and written with its source, date and confidence; tips that fail are recorded as "doesn't work for us". **Practice tasks with deadlines** (e.g. get a new page indexed within 3 days, a long-tail keyword into Google's top 10, a test campaign under the CPA cap) graded in their appraisals. **Paid data tools** (e.g. an SEO suite) proposed with cost and reason — the owner approves and pays.
- **Filed under:** [S15 · AI 360 Control Room — PR 304–341](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s15--ai-360-control-room--pr-304341)
